title: Cold Caller
description:
We are a fast-growing U.S.-based real estate development company focused on high-quality home renovations and new construction projects in California.



We don’t just build homes — we build efficient systems, strong teams, and scalable operations.



We’re looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and reliable team member who can help support lead generation, client outreach, follow-ups, and CRM management across multiple accounts. Strong communication and organizational skills are essential.

______________________________________________________



**Why This Role is Important**

This role is critical to helping our sales pipeline active and organized. If leads are missed, follow-ups delayed, or CRM records incomplete, opportunities are lost and team performance slows down.



Your job is to make sure that NEVER happens.

______________________________________________________



**What You’ll Be Doing**



As an Inside Sales Agent, you’ll be the frontline sales professional responsible for handling inbound and outbound leads, qualifying motivated sellers, and setting appointments for our acquisitions team. You’ll play a critical role in driving revenue by ensuring only high-quality opportunities move forward.



You’ll work closely with a supportive, performance-driven team that values consistency, ownership, and continuous improvement.



**What We’re Looking For**

Qualifications & Requirements:

* Minimum 6 months of experience as an Inside Sales Agent (REQUIRED)

* Experience handling high-volume inbound and outbound calls

* Background in real estate, wholesaling, acquisitions, or property sales is a strong plus

* Proven ability to qualify leads, uncover motivation, and handle objections

* Confident, professional, and persuasive phone presence

* Excellent English communication skills (clear, neutral accent preferred)

* Strong follow-up skills and ability to nurture leads over time

* Comfortable working with CRM systems, dialers, and lead management tools

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and consistent with data entry and notes

* Self-motivated, reliable, and able to hit daily/weekly call and appointment targets

* Team-oriented mindset with a strong sense of accountability

* Positive attitude and genuine interest in building rapport and long-term relationships



Preferred (Big Plus!)

-Experience with real estate industry

-Experience working with US-based/remote clients



Technical Requirements:

* Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 50 Mbps) with backup connection

* Reliable laptop/desktop and smartphone

* Quiet, distraction-free workspace suitable for sales calls



**Perks/Benefits**

–10 days paid time off (PTO)/holiday

– Maxicare health insurance (PH-based employees)

– Performance-based bonuses per property sold

– SV anniversary & birthday gifts

– 13th Month Pay with the potential to earn 2–3× based on performance and company results

– Company sponsored team travel based on performance and company results



**How to Apply (IMPORTANT)**

To be considered, add the following in one google drive folder and send us the link:

-Your updated resume

-2 to 3 mins. introduction video of relevant experience

-Photo of your workstation

-Screenshot of your device specifications

-Screenshot of your internet speed test results



Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

title: AI Video Creator, Editor
description:
I am looking for a highly skilled AI Video Creator to join our growth team. Your primary mission is to produce high-converting, short-form video ads (5–15 seconds) for TikTok eCommerce campaigns. You must be fluent in the latest generative AI video tools like Veo 3, Kling, and Higgsfield and also understand the nuances of TikTok’s Bottom of Funnel (BOF) advertising strategy. This is not a role for a traditional videographer, I need a performance-focused creative who can iterate quickly and generate scroll-stopping UGC-style content at scale.



Key Responsibilities



AI Video Production: 

Create high-volume, 5–15 second video ads using Veo 3, Kling, and Higgsfield. You will be responsible for generating realistic UGC-style videos, product demos, and lifestyle B-roll that look native to the TikTok platform.



BOF Strategy Execution: 

Design and edit videos specifically for TikTok’s Bottom of Funnel (BOF) objectives. You understand that BOF creative requires a direct hook, reinforced value, and urgency, rather than broad top-of-funnel awareness tactics .



Rapid Iteration & Testing: 

Produce multiple variations of hooks, scripts, and CTAs to combat creative fatigue. You should be able to test different angles and scale the winners.



Prompt Engineering & Consistency: 

Utilize advanced prompting techniques (e.g., the "last-frame carryover" trick) to maintain character and product consistency across multiple scenes and cuts .



Format Mastery: Ensure all deliverables strictly adhere to TikTok’s ad specifications (9:16 vertical, 1080x1920 resolution, safe zones, and optimal bitrates) to ensure smooth playback and approval .

title: Part-Time ABA Denials, Appeals & Billing Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced Medical Billing, Denials & Appeals Specialist to join our team remotely from the Philippines. This is a part-time position requiring 4 hours per day, focused on resolving denied insurance claims, calling payers, independently preparing and submitting appeals, and supporting our revenue cycle management operations.



We are specifically looking for someone with strong U.S. healthcare billing experience who can independently investigate denials, develop effective appeals, communicate with insurance companies, and resolve complex billing issues with minimal supervision. Prior experience with ABA (Applied Behavior Analysis) billing is strongly preferred.



What You'll Do

- Independently investigate and resolve denied, rejected, and underpaid insurance claims.

- Draft, prepare, and submit detailed insurance appeals, including medical necessity and authorization-related appeals, using appropriate clinical documentation.

- Identify the root causes of denials and determine the appropriate corrective actions.

- Contact insurance companies to dispute denials, request reconsiderations, and follow up on outstanding claims.

- Correct and resubmit claims when necessary to secure payment.

- Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs), remittance advice, and payer policies to identify reimbursement issues.

- Maintain accurate records of denials, appeals, follow-ups, and resolutions.

- Proactively identify recurring billing issues and recommend improvements to reduce future denials.

- Coordinate with clinical and operational teams when additional documentation is needed to support appeals.



Required Qualifications

- Previous experience in U.S. healthcare medical billing, insurance denials, and appeals.

- Demonstrated ability to independently draft and submit insurance appeals, rather than simply tracking or following up on denials.

- Strong understanding of medical claims, insurance authorizations, payer requirements, and reimbursement processes.

- Experience communicating directly with U.S. insurance companies to resolve complex claims.

- Ability to independently research billing issues, determine next steps, and follow through until resolution.

- Exceptional English communication skills: C2-level / near-native English proficiency.

- Excellent written English with the ability to draft clear, professional, and persuasive appeal letters without significant editing.

- Strong critical-thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

- High attention to detail, organization, and accountability.



Strongly Preferred

- Previous billing and appeals experience with an ABA therapy company.

- Familiarity with ABA CPT codes, including 97151, 97153, and 97155.

- Experience appealing medical necessity denials, authorization denials, and reimbursement disputes.

- Experience with Medicaid managed care organizations and commercial insurance payers.

- Experience using ABA practice-management platforms such as PassageHealth, CentralReach, Rethink, or similar systems.

- Experience managing appeals from initial denial through final resolution.



Position Details

- Location: Remote – Philippines

- Schedule: Part-time, 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday

- Hours: 20 hours per week

- Focus: Insurance denials, appeals, claims resolution, and medical billing



Application Questions: Please answer all of the following questions in your application. We are looking for specific, detailed answers that demonstrate your actual experience.



- Billing Experience: How many years of experience do you have with U.S. healthcare billing, denials, and appeals? Have you worked specifically with ABA therapy providers?

- Appeal Writing: Have you independently written formal medical necessity or authorization-related appeal letters? Please describe your experience and the types of supporting documentation you typically include.

- Software & Availability: Which billing or practice-management systems have you used? Are you available to work 4 hours per day, Monday through Friday, with some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time?



Attention to Detail Check

- Attention to detail is critical in this position. To demonstrate that you have carefully read the job description, please begin your application with the exact phrase "Buzz ABA Appeals Specialist – Detail Verified" before answering the application questions.



Applications that do not follow this instruction or fail to answer the screening questions may not be considered.



Important: This is not an entry-level medical billing position. We are looking for an experienced professional who can take ownership of denials and appeals, exercise independent judgment, and consistently move claims toward successful resolution without requiring step-by-step direction.

title: Finance & Franchise Performance Manager (Xero)
description:
# Finance & Franchise Performance Manager (Xero)



**Company:** Samba Soccer Schools Global Ltd  

**Location:** Remote – Philippines  

**Salary:** $500 USD per month  

**Working Days:** Monday–Friday  

**Working Hours:** 9:00am–6:00pm UK time (36 hours per week, including paid breaks)  

**Position:** Long-term, part-time



## About Samba Soccer Schools



Samba Soccer Schools is a growing UK-based children's football coaching organisation operating across multiple locations through both our company-owned operating business and a network of independently operated franchise businesses.



As our franchise network continues to expand, we are looking for an experienced, proactive and commercially minded finance professional to join our team.



This person will be responsible for supporting the financial operations of both our main operating business and our franchise network, ensuring accurate bookkeeping, effective financial management, consistent reporting and strong financial performance.



You will work closely with the Managing Director, our UK accountants and individual franchise partners.



**This is not simply a bookkeeping or data-entry position.**



We want someone who understands how businesses operate financially, can interpret financial information, identify problems early, recommend improvements and help franchise partners become more financially successful.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Main Operating Business – Financial Management



You will help manage the day-to-day financial operations of Samba Soccer Schools' main operating business.



Responsibilities include:



- Maintaining accurate bookkeeping records using Xero.

- Completing monthly bank reconciliations.

- Monitoring revenue, expenditure, invoices and supplier payments.

- Tracking accounts payable and receivable.

- Monitoring company cash flow and preparing forecasts.

- Reviewing monthly profit and loss statements.

- Tracking budgets and identifying overspending.

- Monitoring recurring costs, subscriptions and supplier expenses.

- Identifying cost-saving opportunities.

- Preparing weekly and monthly financial summaries for the Managing Director.

- Working with our external UK accountants to ensure accurate financial records and compliance.



### 2. Franchise Network – Monthly Bookkeeping



You will also be responsible for managing and coordinating the monthly bookkeeping requirements across our growing network of franchise businesses.



Responsibilities include:



- Maintaining bookkeeping records for individual franchisees using Xero.

- Completing monthly bank reconciliations for franchise businesses.

- Ensuring income and expenditure are correctly categorised.

- Reviewing transactions and investigating discrepancies.

- Monitoring outstanding invoices and financial commitments.

- Ensuring bookkeeping is completed accurately and on time each month.

- Maintaining consistent charts of accounts across franchise businesses.

- Working with our external accountants to ensure records are accurate and ready for statutory and tax reporting.



Each franchise must have accurate, organised and up-to-date financial information.



### 3. Franchise Financial Onboarding



When new franchise partners join Samba Soccer Schools, you will take responsibility for supporting the financial onboarding process.



This includes:



- Guiding franchisees through the financial setup of their businesses.

- Coordinating the setup and configuration of Xero.

- Ensuring the correct chart of accounts is implemented.

- Supporting the setup of bank feeds and accounting processes.

- Explaining how franchisees should manage income, expenditure and financial records.

- Educating new franchisees on bookkeeping responsibilities and financial procedures.

- Ensuring each franchise follows our standardised reporting structure.

- Liaising with franchisees and accountants to resolve financial setup issues.



Our goal is for every franchise partner to start their business with the correct financial systems, processes and understanding in place.



### 4. Franchise Financial Performance Monitoring



A major part of this role involves actively monitoring the financial performance of our franchise network.



You will:



- Review monthly revenue, operating costs and profitability for each franchise.

- Monitor profit margins and overall financial health.

- Compare actual results against budgets and forecasts.

- Identify franchisees experiencing financial difficulties.

- Monitor trends in revenue, expenses and profitability.

- Analyse venue-level profitability where data is available.

- Identify unnecessary costs and opportunities to improve financial performance.

- Track outstanding franchise fees, royalties and other financial obligations.

- Produce meaningful financial insights and recommendations.



We want someone who can look at financial reports and explain **what the numbers mean, why performance is changing and what action should be taken.**



### 5. Monthly Franchise Financial Reporting



You will be responsible for preparing and distributing monthly financial performance reports to franchise partners.



Each report should provide a clear overview of the franchise's financial performance, including:



- Monthly revenue.

- Operating expenditure.

- Gross and net profitability.

- Profit margins.

- Cash-flow position.

- Performance against budgets or previous periods.

- Significant changes in income or expenditure.

- Areas of financial concern.

- Recommendations to improve profitability.



Reports must be accurate, easy to understand and consistent across the franchise network.



You will also provide the Managing Director with a consolidated overview of franchise financial performance.



### 6. Financial Education & Franchise Support



We want our franchise partners to become financially knowledgeable and capable business owners.



You will play an important role in developing their financial understanding and commercial awareness.



Responsibilities include:



- Helping franchisees understand their profit and loss statements.

- Explaining the difference between revenue, profit and cash flow.

- Educating franchisees on budgeting and financial planning.

- Helping franchisees understand their operating costs and profit margins.

- Explaining how to identify unnecessary expenditure.

- Supporting franchisees with financial questions.

- Helping franchisees understand how financial decisions affect profitability.

- Providing practical recommendations to improve business performance.



You must be confident explaining financial concepts in simple, clear English to people who may not have an accounting background.



### 7. Early Identification of Financial Problems



One of the most important responsibilities of this position is identifying financial problems before they become serious.



You will be expected to proactively monitor the finances of both our operating business and franchise network.



Examples include:



- A franchise consistently operating at a loss.

- Rapidly increasing operating costs.

- Significant reductions in revenue.

- Poor cash-flow management.

- Unpaid invoices or overdue financial obligations.

- Unusual transactions or financial discrepancies.

- Potential cash shortages.

- Franchisees spending beyond their available budgets.

- Unexpected changes in profitability.



**Any significant financial concern must be flagged directly to the Managing Director as early as possible, together with an explanation of the issue and recommended actions.**



We do not want someone who simply reports financial problems after they have happened.



We want someone proactive who can anticipate risks and help prevent them.



### 8. Financial Reporting & Management Dashboards



You will also help develop and maintain financial reporting systems for the wider business.



This includes:



- Preparing monthly management accounts.

- Maintaining cash-flow forecasts.

- Creating Excel or Google Sheets financial dashboards.

- Monitoring key financial performance indicators.

- Producing weekly financial summaries for management.

- Comparing performance across franchise businesses.

- Identifying trends and opportunities for improvement.

- Supporting the Managing Director with financial analysis and business decisions.



## Required Skills & Experience



- Minimum 2–3 years of professional bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Strong hands-on experience using Xero.

- Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple businesses or clients.

- Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Ability to prepare and interpret profit and loss statements, balance sheets and cash-flow reports.

- Experience with bank reconciliations and monthly financial reporting.

- Good understanding of budgeting, profitability and cash-flow management.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently, manage deadlines and take ownership of responsibilities.



## Highly Desirable



- Previous experience supporting UK businesses.

- Understanding of UK accounting practices and VAT.

- Experience working with franchise businesses or multi-location companies.

- Experience preparing management accounts and financial dashboards.

- Experience supporting business owners with financial planning.

- Accounting qualification or relevant university degree.

- Experience training or explaining financial concepts to non-finance professionals.



## The Person We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



- Highly organised, reliable and trustworthy.

- Confident working with financial information.

- Proactive rather than reactive.

- Commercially minded and interested in business performance.

- Comfortable communicating directly with business owners.

- Able to explain complicated financial information simply.

- Confident identifying problems and recommending solutions.

- Capable of managing multiple businesses and deadlines.

- Interested in building a long-term career with our company.



We value initiative, ownership and accountability.



If you notice a problem, we want you to raise it.



If you identify an opportunity to improve profitability, we want you to recommend it.



If a franchise partner is struggling financially, we want you to help them understand why and what they can do about it.



## What We Offer



- $500 USD monthly salary.

- Consistent Monday–Friday working schedule.

- Long-term opportunity with a growing UK company.

- Direct working relationship with the Managing Director.

- Opportunity to work across multiple businesses.

- Exposure to franchise operations and business financial management.

- Potential for career progression and salary reviews based on performance.



## How to Apply

title: Experienced Full-Time Bookkeeper | QuickBooks Online
description:
We are looking for an experienced full-time bookkeeper to take ownership of the books for multiple US companies.



The work includes cleaning up existing records, maintaining current books, managing accounts receivable and payable, and preparing reliable financial reports.



We need someone who already has an established bookkeeping process and can work independently. We will provide access, business context, and company-specific information. We expect you to know how to organize the work, identify problems, and complete it without step-by-step bookkeeping training.



Schedule



• Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

• Working hours: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time.

• You must follow US Eastern Time, including daylight saving changes.

• You must be available and responsive during your agreed working hours.

• Any existing commitments must not overlap with this schedule or interfere with your responsibilities.



Responsibilities



• Review each company’s books and identify errors, missing records, unreconciled accounts, and overdue work.

• Create a cleanup plan with priorities, realistic deadlines, and a clear list of documents needed.

• Record and categorize transactions accurately in QuickBooks Online.

• Reconcile bank, credit card, and payment processor accounts.

• Investigate discrepancies and correct errors with proper supporting documentation.

• Handle transfers, loans, owner contributions, and transactions between companies correctly.

• Manage accounts receivable, including invoicing, payment tracking, aging reports, and follow-ups on overdue balances.

• Maintain accounts payable and flag upcoming obligations for approval.

• Prepare monthly profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and reconciliation reports.

• Keep each company’s records, documents, and outstanding issues separate and organized.

• Coordinate the handover from existing bookkeepers and document unresolved items.

• Provide brief daily updates and a weekly progress summary for each company.

• Flag blockers early and follow through without repeated reminders.

• Protect confidential financial information and follow account security requirements.



Who we are looking for



• At least three years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, including at least two years using QuickBooks Online for actual businesses.

• Experience handling books for US companies.

• Experience managing multiple companies at the same time.

• Proven cleanup, catch-up bookkeeping, and reconciliation experience.

• Working knowledge of cash and accrual accounting, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and month-end closing.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• An established system for tracking deadlines, reconciliations, missing documents, and completed work.

• The judgment to investigate discrepancies and ask specific questions when information is missing.

• Clear communication, consistent attendance, and dependable follow-through.



QuickBooks certification is welcome, but it does not replace practical experience.



What we expect after you start



During your first week, review the status of each company and present a prioritized work plan. From there, we expect measurable weekly progress, accurate records, and clear communication about anything affecting delivery.



You should be able to explain what is complete, what remains outstanding, and when the next deliverable will be ready.



How to apply



Use this exact subject format:



SYSTEMS - Your Full Name



Include the following numbered answers in your application. Please do not send only a résumé or a general cover letter.



Résumé

Provide a viewable link to your updated résumé.



Bookkeeping experience

State your total years of bookkeeping experience, years using QuickBooks Online, and experience with US companies. Separate actual client work from training or practice exercises.



Multiple-company experience

How many companies have you handled at the same time? What types of businesses were they, and which responsibilities did you personally manage?



Your existing system

Describe the process you currently use to manage multiple companies, reconciliations, month-end deadlines, missing documents, and progress updates. Explain how you would apply it to this role. You may include an anonymized checklist or tracker, but do not disclose client information.



Cleanup example

Describe one difficult bookkeeping issue you personally resolved. What was wrong, what did you do, and how did you verify the correction?



Accounts receivable

Describe your experience with invoicing, tracking payments, reviewing aging reports, and following up on overdue accounts.



Expected compensation

State your expected fixed monthly rate in USD for 40 hours per week.



Availability and current commitments

Confirm whether you can work Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time, including daylight saving changes. List any current work commitments and their schedules without naming clients. State your earliest start date.



Certifications and references

List any relevant certifications. Confirm whether you can provide two professional references who have directly supervised or reviewed your bookkeeping work. Contact details will be requested later.



Applications that do not follow the subject format or answer all required questions will not move forward.



Hiring process



Shortlisted applicants will complete a brief bookkeeping assessment using fictional records, followed by an interview.



Before access to company records is granted, the selected candidate will complete reference checks, provide basic onboarding information and an emergency contact, and agree to confidentiality and account security requirements.

title: Web Editor - SEE BER-MONTH HIRING BONUS!
description:
**BER-MONTH HIRING BONUS**

We are happy to offer a $150 USD sign-on bonus in December!





ABOUT SHOP MARKETING PROS:

We are a marketing agency based in the United States with a stateside and international team of over 50 professionals. Shop Marketing Pros is a very well-respected and rapidly growing Digital Marketing Company in the Automotive Repair Industry with strong core values and a superb track record of serving its clients better than competitors. Our key services include Website Design, Digital Advertising, Search Engine Optimization, and Social Media Management. 



Our Core Values are of incredible importance to us. We live by our “SHIELD” so please visit 
/core-values/ and familiarize yourself with our Core Values before continuing. Please continue with this job description and application if you feel you align with these values.





BENEFITS + PERKS

1) This is a full-time, permanent, independent contractor, remote position from Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm U.S. Central Time.

2) Unlimited PTO (after 90 days of engagement)

3) HMO of up to $25/month (after 90 days of engagement) 

4) Eight (8) Paid Holiday Leaves (local holidays) 

5) Paid time off beginning Christmas Eve until New Year’s Day (we plan to continue offering this as long as it is feasible)

6) An extraordinary team/company culture





JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shop Marketing Pros is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Web Editor to join our team of PROs. Your primary focus will be managing the website edits queue, both for our clients and Shop Marketing Pros, accurately and on time. Working primarily in WordPress and Elementor, you will update content, add new pages, revise existing pages, and make light web design and development adjustments while maintaining each website’s established design and functionality.



You will work most closely with the Web Project Manager and Webmaster to clarify requests, prioritize work, and keep edits moving toward completion. You will also communicate with clients by
 to ask clarifying questions and promptly notify them and our internal teams when edits are complete. We are widely known for timely website edits, and this is a key focus for this role. Success means delivering accurate, thoroughly checked edits within agreed timelines and keeping everyone informed throughout the process.





REQUIRED SKILLS:

The ideal candidate has:

Hands-on experience editing WordPress websites.

Proficiency with Elementor, including editing existing pages and adapting approved templates.

Ability to check content accuracy and test links, forms, and page layouts across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Ability to apply established design standards for spacing, typography, alignment, and responsive layouts.

Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for minor formatting and styling corrections.

Basic web design knowledge.

Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple editing requests, prioritize tasks, meet agreed deadlines, follow documented processes, provide timely updates to clients and internal teams, clarify requirements, and escalate issues when necessary.

Proficiency in accurately interpreting and implementing submitted website edit requests, with strong attention to detail to ensure all requested changes are completed correctly.

Ability to optimize images for website use, including resizing, cropping, compressing, and maintaining image quality.

Basic understanding of on-page SEO, heading structure, descriptive links, and image alt text.



Not Required, but helpful:

Familiarity with Rank Math or similar WordPress SEO tools.

Basic JavaScript familiarity for adding embed codes and tracking scripts.

Experience using design tools such as Adobe Photoshop or Figma to make basic graphic edits, website visuals, and design adjustments.

Experience using ClickUp or similar project management tools.

Ability to follow Figma mockups and design guidelines.

Experience with digital marketing agencies, local service businesses, or auto repair websites.





JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Own and manage the website edits queue, prioritizing client and internal requests and tracking each edit through completion to meet agreed deadlines.

Update approved text, images, service information, business hours, buttons, links, menus, and other content across client and SMP websites; resize, crop, and compress supplied images for web use within established guidelines.

Make routine Elementor layout and page-structure adjustments and minor HTML/CSS corrections while preserving each client’s branding and established design; identify visual inconsistencies and seek design or development guidance when needed.

Create and publish pages from approved templates, and format and publish approved blog posts, podcasts, and other supplied content.

Verify client-specific details, including shop names, service offerings, contact information, and calls to action, against approved source material.

Perform quality checks after each edit across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices; test relevant links, buttons, and forms, correct editing errors, and confirm that approved changes are live.

Apply approved SEO and content instructions for page titles, meta descriptions, heading structure, image alt text, and internal and external links.

Manage assigned requests, clarify incomplete instructions, provide progress updates, flag deadline risks, and document completed work and quality checks.

Resolve routine content, formatting, and page-builder issues within approved access and processes; document issues beyond the scope of an editing request and seek guidance from the appropriate team member.

Coordinate with other team members in suggesting practical improvements to editing templates and workflows.





INSTRUCTIONS FOR APPLICATION:

1) Use this subject line: “SMP Web Editor - [Your Nickname]"

2) In your cover letter, mention which of our core values resonates with you the most.

3) Include a link to your resume.

4) Please use at least 7 OLJ points to qualify for this role.

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & MARKETING SPECIALIST – HEALTHCARE



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Business Hours



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month



ABOUT RAVORA HEALTH



Ravora Health is a growing U.S.-based outpatient mental health practice providing psychiatric evaluation, medication management, ADHD treatment, and care for conditions such as anxiety and depression.



We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Business Development & Marketing Specialist to help us grow our patient base, develop relationships with healthcare referral partners, and execute marketing and growth projects.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys research, outreach, relationship building, marketing, and solving problems.



You will work directly with Ravora Health leadership and will be given meaningful projects to own.



We are looking for someone who can take an objective, figure out what needs to be done, organize the project, execute it, follow up, and report the results.



WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON



1. HEALTHCARE BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT



A major responsibility will be helping Ravora Health build relationships with healthcare organizations that may refer patients to us.



Potential referral partners include:



* Primary care offices

* Therapy and counseling practices

* Psychologists

* Healthcare clinics

* Community organizations

* Colleges and universities

* Other healthcare professionals



Your responsibilities may include:



* Researching potential referral partners

* Finding the appropriate decision-makers and contacts

* Collecting accurate phone numbers and
 addresses

* Researching services and accepted insurance plans

* Calling and
ing healthcare offices

* Introducing Ravora Health and our services

* Explaining our accepted insurance plans and referral process

* Learning how potential partners currently handle psychiatry referrals

* Scheduling meetings when appropriate

* Following up with contacts

* Maintaining long-term relationships



This is relationship-focused business development, not high-volume call-center telemarketing.



2. LEAD GENERATION & RESEARCH



You will help identify new opportunities for Ravora Health.



This may include:



* Building targeted prospect lists

* Researching healthcare organizations

* Identifying decision-makers

* Researching competitors

* Finding community organizations

* Researching local businesses and employers

* Finding potential referral sources

* Identifying marketing opportunities

* Researching new patient-acquisition channels



We want someone who is very comfortable researching online and turning information into an organized action plan.



3. REFERRAL & CONTACT DATABASE MANAGEMENT



You will help create and maintain an organized database or CRM containing information such as:



* Organization name

* Contact person

* Phone

*

* Location

* Providers

* Accepted insurance

* Services offered

* Previous communication

* Relationship status

* Last contact

* Follow-up date

* Referrals generated



You will help make sure opportunities do not get forgotten and relationships are followed up consistently.



4. DIGITAL MARKETING & PATIENT ACQUISITION



You will also assist with marketing projects designed to bring new patients to Ravora Health.



Projects may involve:



* Google Ads

* Google Business Profile

* Local SEO

* Psychology Today

* Zocdoc

* Insurance directories

* Website landing pages

*
 campaigns

* Review-generation strategies

* Provider launches

* Referral campaigns

* Social media campaigns

* Patient acquisition tracking



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



However, you should understand digital marketing and be comfortable learning new platforms.



Google Ads experience is strongly preferred but not required.



5. NETWORKING & COMMUNITY OUTREACH



Help us identify and coordinate opportunities for Ravora Health to build relationships in the community.



Examples may include:



* Healthcare networking events

* Therapist networking events

* Mental health events

* Health fairs

* Chamber of Commerce events

* Local business networking events

* College events

* Community events

* Ravora-hosted networking events



Responsibilities may include:



* Finding opportunities

* Contacting event organizers

* Gathering pricing and participation information

* Coordinating registration

* Maintaining an event calendar

* Helping prepare marketing materials

* Tracking contacts made

* Following up after events



6. MARKETING PROJECTS



You will regularly receive projects directly from Ravora Health leadership.



Examples:



"Find therapy practices in our target area that could become referral partners."



"Research PCP offices that accept the same insurance plans we accept."



"Create a system for tracking our referral relationships."



"Find networking events Ravora should attend over the next three months."



"Help us launch and market a new provider."



"Research why a particular marketing channel isn't generating enough patients."



"Find new ways we can acquire patients locally."



We are looking for someone who does not need every project broken down into individual instructions.



You should be comfortable researching, asking good questions, creating a plan, and taking ownership of execution.



AI & TECHNOLOGY



We strongly encourage the use of AI and modern technology.



Experience with tools such as the following is valuable:



* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity

* Canva

* CRM systems

* Google Workspace

* Project-management tools

* Automation tools



We want someone who looks for ways to use technology to make research, outreach, organization, and marketing more efficient.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you have experience in areas such as:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Marketing

* Healthcare

* Client relations

* Account management

* Partnership development

* Outreach

* Digital marketing

* Google Ads

* CRM management

* Project coordination

* Sales development



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare company is a strong advantage but is not required.



IMPORTANT QUALIFICATIONS



You should have:



* Excellent spoken English

* Excellent written English

* Confidence speaking professionally on the phone

* Strong research skills

* Strong organizational skills

* Good follow-up habits

* Professional communication skills

* Ability to work independently

* Attention to detail

* Comfort with outbound outreach

* Ability to learn new tools quickly

* Ability to manage several projects

* Good judgment and problem-solving skills



You must be comfortable communicating with U.S. healthcare offices during U.S. business hours.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST



We are not searching for someone who already knows everything.



We are searching for someone who is:



* Resourceful

* Reliable

* Organized

* Curious

* Comfortable taking initiative

* Strong at communication

* Willing to learn

* Comfortable using AI

* Able to take ownership of assignments



If we give you a goal, we want you to be able to research it, create a plan, execute it, follow up, and show us what happened.



COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



Hours: 40 hours per week



Salary: ₱35,000–₱45,000 PHP per month depending on experience and skill level.



Because a significant part of this position involves communicating with U.S. healthcare offices, you must be available during a meaningful portion of U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



This is intended to be a long-term role.



Compensation and responsibilities may be reviewed after the first 90 days based on performance, reliability, project ownership, and overall contribution.



HOW TO APPLY



Please begin your application with the words:



RAVORA GROWTH



Then include the following:



1. INTRODUCTION



Tell us briefly about your background and why this position interests you.



2. RESUME



Please include your current resume or CV.



3. VOICE RECORDING



Please provide a short 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself.



A major part of this role involves professional communication with U.S. healthcare offices, so spoken English is important.



4. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Tell us about any experience you have with:



* Business development

* Lead generation

* Healthcare

* Marketing

* Client outreach

* Google Ads

* CRM systems

* Project coordination



5. PROJECT OWNERSHIP



Tell us about one project where you were given a goal but not detailed step-by-step instructions.



What was the goal?



What did you do?



What was the result?



6. SHORT CASE STUDY



Imagine Ravora Health asks you:



"We want to build relationships with local therapy practices and primary care offices that could refer psychiatric patients to us."



Briefly explain how you would begin this project.



We are especially interested in how you would:



* Find potential partners

* D
 which organizations to prioritize

* Contact them

* Track your outreach

* Follow up

* Measure results



7. AI TOOLS



Tell us which AI tools you currently use and give us one example of how you have used AI to complete work more efficiently.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with Ravora Health and become an important member of our business development and marketing team.

title: Experienced US Truck Dispatcher – Hiring Now!
description:
Join an Established US-Based Transportation & Logistics Company!



Are you an experienced US Truck Dispatcher looking for a stable, long-term career opportunity with an established transportation company?

We are a US-based transportation and logistics company with over 15 years of successful industry experience, and we are looking for a motivated, reliable, and experienced US Truck Dispatcher to join our team.

We value professionalism, strong communication skills, accountability, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES



* Monitor the US freight market, negotiate competitive rates, and secure profitable loads using DAT and other available load boards.

* Manage daily dispatch operations for company drivers and Owner-Operators.

* Communicate daily with freight brokers on behalf of the carrier to secure loads, negotiate rates, and coordinate shipments.

* Develop and maintain professional relationships with freight brokers and establish new business connections.

* Manage driver schedules, dispatch operations, pickup and delivery appointments.

* Understand and monitor ELD hours of service (HOS) to ensure efficient and compliant driver scheduling.

* Provide support to drivers on the road, including assistance with breakdowns, delays, and unexpected situations.

* Handle daily Track & Trace operations and monitor shipment progress.

* Maintain accurate records of calls, loads, routes, pickup and delivery times, and other operational details.

* Prepare and review reports, spreadsheets, and daily performance updates.



REQUIREMENTS



* Minimum 3 years of proven experience as a Truck Dispatcher working directly for a US-based trucking carrier (transportation company).

* Previous experience managing company drivers or Owner-Operators and handling their daily dispatch operations.

* Strong understanding of carrier-side operations, including load planning, rate negotiations, driver scheduling, and maximizing truck utilization.

* Experience communicating with freight brokers on behalf of a trucking carrier to secure loads and negotiate rates.

* Ability to independently manage trucks, coordinate pickups and deliveries, and handle daily operational challenges.

* Existing professional relationships with Owner-Operators and a proven ability to build and maintain long-term driver relationships are a major advantage.

* Strong understanding of US geography, interstate routes, time zones, and regional trucking regulations.

* Hands-on experience with Track & Trace operations.

* Good understanding of ELD systems and Hours of Service (HOS) regulations.

* Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

* Strong organizational, analytical, and multitasking abilities.

* Ability to work independently, make decisions under pressure, and take full responsibility for assigned trucks.

* Willingness to work an night shift ( PHT ) aligned with US business hours.



IMPORTANT: We are specifically looking for candidates with hands-on experience working directly for a US trucking carrier. This is NOT a freight brokerage, freight sales, or broker agent position. Candidates whose experience is limited to freight brokerage will not be considered.



WHAT WE OFFER



* Long-term employment opportunity with an established company operating for over 15 years.

* Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications.

* Stable working environment and professional management.

* Opportunities for career growth and professional development.

* Supportive and team-oriented workplace.

* Opportunity to become part of an experienced US trucking operations team.



HOW TO APPLY



If you have solid experience in US trucking dispatching and are looking for a stable, long-term opportunity, we would like to hear from you!



Please send us your updated CV and contact information.



When applying, please include:



* Your total years of experience in US trucking dispatching.

* The type and number of trucks you have previously dispatched.

* Whether you worked directly for a US trucking carrier.

* Your experience working with Owner-Operators and company drivers.



We are looking for an experienced professional who understands carrier operations, takes ownership of their work, and can become a valuable long-term member of our team.

title: Content Production Manager | LinkedIn, Instagram, AI & Marketing
description:
Company: Confidential | US-Based Boutique Consulting & Marketing Firm

Schedule: Full-Time, 40 Hours per Week  

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM US Central Time (1-hour break, 8 working hours daily)  

Position: Long-Term



#About the Company



We're a boutique consulting and marketing firm that helps real estate investment companies and developers strengthen their online presence, communicate with investors, and grow their businesses.



Our services include brand positioning, websites, CRM systems, LinkedIn and Instagram content, newsletters, webinars, and organic marketing.



We're a small, growing company looking for an experienced Content Production Manager who can take ownership of producing, organizing, and publishing marketing content for both our clients and our own business.



Our founder handles client strategy, positioning, business development, and overall marketing direction. We're looking for someone who can take that direction and turn it into high-quality, finished content with minimal supervision.



About the Role



**We're not looking for someone who simply schedules posts or copies and pastes AI-generated content.**



We're looking for a skilled content producer who understands LinkedIn and Instagram, writes excellent English, knows how to use AI effectively, and can manage the entire content production process.



You'll work directly with our founder to turn ideas, strategy, meeting transcripts, interviews, and existing materials into engaging social media posts, newsletters, webinar presentations, and marketing campaigns.



You'll use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Canva, and GoHighLevel to produce content efficiently while maintaining each client's unique voice, messaging, and brand standards.



Your responsibility is to create polished deliverables for clients, submit them for review, incorporate feedback, and schedule or publish approved content.



You'll also help manage our firm's own organic marketing, including LinkedIn, Instagram, newsletters, and other initiatives designed to grow our audience and attract new clients.



This is a hands-on production role. You will be expected to personally create and manage content rather than simply assign work to others.



Key Responsibilities



1. LinkedIn Content Production & Management



- Ghostwrite LinkedIn posts for business owners, executives, and client accounts with AI

- Turn ideas, interviews, transcripts, articles, and other source materials into engaging posts.

- Write strong hooks, compelling stories, and clear calls to action.

- Maintain distinct writing styles and brand voices for different clients.

- Create and format carousels, graphics, and other supporting content.

- Prepare and maintain LinkedIn content calendars.

- Schedule and publish approved content, prioritizing morning publishing schedules with MagicPost.

- Assist with relevant, professional engagement on client and company accounts, following approved guidelines.

- Monitor performance and recommend improvements based on engagement and results.

- Stay current on LinkedIn content formats, platform developments, and best practices.



You must have a thorough understanding of LinkedIn as a content marketing platform, including what makes posts engaging and how businesses use LinkedIn to build authority, develop relationships, and attract clients.



2. Instagram Content Production & Management



- Develop Instagram posts, captions, carousels, graphics, and Reel concepts.

- Repurpose long-form content and LinkedIn posts into Instagram-native content (video editing).

- Light video editing understanding required. Can use AI, but some tools may be needed.

- Write engaging hooks, captions, and short-form video scripts.

- Create branded graphics and carousels using AI, Canva or similar tools.

- Assist with basic short-form video editing and content preparation.

- Manage Instagram content calendars, scheduling, and publishing.

- Support appropriate account engagement and community interactions according to approved guidelines.

- Understand Instagram content formats, audience behavior, engagement strategies, and platform best practices.

- Review performance metrics and recommend content improvements.



We need someone who understands that LinkedIn and Instagram require different approaches. Simply reposting identical content across both platforms is not sufficient.



3. AI-Assisted Content Creation



AI will play a significant role in our production process.



- Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to research, draft, edit, and improve content.

- Develop and refine prompts and repeatable AI-assisted content workflows.

- Transform meeting transcripts, interviews, and client notes into usable marketing content.

- Edit AI-generated drafts to remove generic language, repetitive phrasing, and unnatural writing.

- Maintain brand voice, accuracy, and messaging consistency.

- Research and verify information before including it in published content.

- Identify opportunities to improve production speed without sacrificing quality.



We value strong writing and editorial judgment more than simply knowing how to generate content with AI.



You should be capable of recognizing weak copy and improving it independently before submitting anything for review.



4. Newsletter, Blog &
 Marketing Production



- Draft and edit blogs & newsletters using client-provided ideas, materials, and AI-assisted workflows.

- Format newsletters and
 campaigns inside GoHighLevel.

- Add blogs to websites once approved (GoHighLevel, Wordpress)

- Add images, links, formatting, and calls to action.

- Manage
 campaign preparation, scheduling, and approved audience segments.

- Test
s, links, formatting, and mobile responsiveness.

- Coordinate review and approval before sending.

- Maintain newsletter calendars and publishing schedules.

- Assist with
 nurture sequences and other marketing campaigns.



5. Webinar Production & Coordination



- Prepare webinar outlines, presentation copy, and slide decks using AI and presentation tools.

- Format presentations using existing templates and brand guidelines.

- Coordinate revisions and prepare final presentations for review.

- Create and configure webinar registrations using Zoom, Eventbrite, and related platforms.

- Build or update registration pages and forms in GoHighLevel.

- Configure confirmation
s, reminders, and follow-up sequences.

- Test registration workflows, integrations, and communication sequences before events.

- Help coordinate webinar promotional content and post-event communications.



You don't need to be an advanced graphic designer, but you should be comfortable producing professional presentations using AI, Canva, PowerPoint, or similar tools.



6. Content Management & Quality Control



- Maintain content calendars for multiple clients and our own company.

- Organize drafts, approved content, graphics, presentations, and other marketing assets.

- Track deadlines and ensure deliverables are submitted on time.

- Manage feedback and revisions efficiently.

- Proofread all content for grammar, accuracy, formatting, and consistency.

- Ensure content follows each client's voice, brand guidelines, and messaging.

- Verify all content is approved before publishing.

- Maintain organized project documentation and content workflows.

- Identify ways to streamline production and improve efficiency.



7. Internal Marketing & Business Growth



Alongside client projects, you'll help execute our firm's own marketing initiatives and help with the Founders social media strategy, posts, and engagement.



This includes:



- Producing and scheduling content for our founder's LinkedIn profile.

- Creating and managing Instagram content.

- Helping produce our company newsletter.

- Repurposing articles, webinars, and other materials into social media content.

- Creating graphics, carousels, and other marketing assets.

- Supporting lead magnets, landing pages, and
 campaigns.

- Helping execute marketing initiatives that support audience growth and lead generation.

- Recommending ways to improve our content production process.



We're still growing, and there's no shortage of opportunities to help build our brand.



Required Qualifications



- 3+ years of professional experience in content creation, content marketing, social media management, or a similar role.

- Proven experience producing content for both LinkedIn and Instagram.

- Thorough understanding of LinkedIn and Instagram content strategy, platform-specific audience behavior, engagement, and content formats.

- Excellent written English, including grammar, storytelling, editing, and persuasive writing.

- Demonstrated experience ghostwriting or creating content for business owners, executives, or B2B brands.

- Strong proficiency using ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI tools for content production.

- Ability to independently edit and improve AI-generated content.

- Experience using Canva or similar design tools.

- Experience managing content calendars, approvals, scheduling, and publishing.

- Ability to create professional social media graphics and presentation materials.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple brands while maintaining distinct messaging and writing styles.

- Comfortable receiving feedback, making revisions, and working independently.

- Must be able to work Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM US Central Time, with a 1-hour break.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working for a content marketing agency or managing multiple client accounts.

- Experience with GoHighLevel, including
 campaigns, workflows, forms, and landing pages.

- Experience creating newsletters and
 marketing campaigns.

- Familiarity with Zoom, Eventbrite, and webinar registration workflows.

- Experience preparing presentations using Canva, PowerPoint, Gamma, or similar tools.

- Basic video editing experience using CapCut or similar software.

- Experience producing content from podcast recordings, interviews, or meeting transcripts.

- Familiarity with tools such as Fathom, Descript, or other transcription platforms.

- Experience with social media scheduling and analytics tools.

- Experience with B2B marketing, real estate, investing, or financial services.

- Experience building AI-assisted content workflows and reusable prompt libraries.



Experience in real estate investing or capital raising is a plus, but not required.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who genuinely understands content and takes pride in producing great work.



You understand the difference between an engaging LinkedIn post and generic corporate content.



You know how to adapt an idea for Instagram instead of simply reposting the same content.



You can take a 30-minute interview transcript and turn it into several strong content ideas.



You know how to use AI to work faster, but you don't blindly trust everything it produces.



You catch awkward writing, inaccurate statements, and weak hooks before submitting your drafts.



You're organized enough to manage multiple clients, content calendars, and deadlines without constant reminders.



You understand the importance of morning social media activity and can consistently begin your workday at 7:00 AM US Central Time.



And you're comfortable working in a small company where responsibilities may evolve as the business grows.



We're looking for someone who can take a content idea and turn it into a finished, professional deliverable that's ready for approval.



We value creativity, initiative, excellent communication, attention to detail, and a willingness to continually improve.



Schedule & Availability



This is a full-time position requiring 40 working hours per week.



Required Schedule: Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM US Central Time, including a 1-hour break.



This is a firm requirement.



We begin our social media activity early in the morning, so you must be available and actively working at 7:00 AM Central Time.



Your responsibilities will include checking scheduled content, preparing morning publishing activities, monitoring accounts, and ensuring daily marketing tasks are moving forward.



Candidates must be able to maintain this schedule consistently, including when US Central Time shifts between daylight saving time and standard time.



Growth Opportunity



We're looking for someone interested in building a long-term relationship and growing alongside our firm.



As our client base expands, this position has the potential to develop into a senior content operations or marketing production leadership role, with opportunities to manage additional content specialists.



You'll have an opportunity to help build our content production systems, improve our AI workflows, and become an important part of a growing consulting and marketing business.



How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Content Production Experience



How many years have you been professionally producing social media or marketing content? What types of businesses or clients have you worked with?



2. LinkedIn & Instagram Portfolio



Provide links to LinkedIn and Instagram accounts you've created content for. Include specific examples of posts, carousels, or campaigns you've personally produced.



3. Writing Samples



Share 2–3 examples of LinkedIn posts, newsletters, or other marketing content you've written. We want to evaluate your actual writing ability.



4. AI Experience



Explain how you currently use ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools in your content production process. What tasks do you use AI for, and how do you ensure the finished content is high quality?



5. Technical Experience



Describe your experience with GoHighLevel, Canva, webinar platforms, social media scheduling tools, and presentation software.



6. Availability & Equipment



Share your country, time zone, and confirm that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM US Central Time, including a 1-hour break.



Please also share your computer specifications, whether you have a working camera and microphone, and your internet connection speed.



Required Scenario Question



You're creating LinkedIn and Instagram content for a real estate investment firm.



The founder provides a 30-minute interview transcript discussing why investors hesitate before committing money to an investment.



They want three LinkedIn posts, two Instagram carousels, and an
 newsletter developed from that conversation.



**Walk us through exactly how you would turn that transcript into finished content.**



Explain how you'd use AI, adapt the material for each platform, maintain the founder's voice, verify accuracy, organize the deliverables, and prepare everything for review and publishing.



We're interested in your actual production process, not just a list of AI tools.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Interior Designer - 2D + 3D Drawing Specialist
description:
My posting:



Interior Designer — 2D & 3D Drawing Support



$5 USD/Hour | Part-Time | Remote (Philippines) | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



About Me & My Businesses



Hi! I’m Kelsey!



I own a boutique residential interior design firm Studio K Interiors. We do mostly new construction projects with a few large scale remodels. We are a full service firm, working with custom millwork crews - so we do a lot of drawings! We have a team of 4 girls (mix of full time and part time). We are a fun group who loves beautiful things. We struggle to keep up with all of the drawing support with the amount of clients and meetings we currently have and are looking for someone in the background to help support that. 



The position would be 



What You’ll Be Doing Initially



We’re going to start small and build from there!



Your main responsibilities will be:

1. Sketchup - we mainly use Sketchup and Layout for all of our 2D and 3D drawings - I am open to using CAD to get more detailed in the future. We create conceptual 3D renderings, detailed elevations and floor plans - most of this work is related to cabinetry, custom millwork, tile layouts, lighting layouts, architecture build based on floorplan etc. 



2. Translating drawings into a Layout or Canva document with detailed notes, dimensions in accordance with our brand templates. Some creative graphic design skill would be a plus! 



The goal is to gradually expand your responsibilities based on your skills, interests, and how our working relationship develops.



Who I’m Looking For



I’m much more interested in finding the right person than someone with a perfect resume.



My ideal designer is:



Organized: You enjoy creating order, keeping things organized, and managing details.



Detail-Oriented: You read instructions carefully, notice small things, and take pride in accurate work.



Proactive: You don’t always wait to be told what needs to happen. You notice things that need attention and suggest solutions.



Resourceful: If you don’t know how to do something, you’re willing to research it, learn, and figure it out.



Technical: a good understanding of US standard dimensions for cabinetry, code etc. 



A Great Communicator: You have excellent written English and can communicate professionally, clearly, and naturally.



Reliable: You follow through on commitments, meet deadlines, and keep me updated.



Creative: You enjoy learning about creative businesses, social media, design, and new projects.



Eager to Learn: You’re excited to develop new skills and gradually take on additional responsibilities.



Most importantly, I’m looking for someone who genuinely cares about doing a good job and wants to be part of something long-term.



I don’t expect perfection, and I know there will be a learning curve.



I do expect effort, attention to detail, honesty, and a willingness to learn.



Required Skills



Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent organizational skills.

High attention to detail.

Basic experience with Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive).

Sketchup

Layout (sketchup)

AutoCAD (not necessary but a plus!)

Good computer and internet skills.

Ability to work independently.

Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Willingness to learn new tools and processes.

Ability to keep business information confidential.

Dependable internet connection.



2-4 years of interior design drawing experience is preferred. 



Bonus Skills



These are helpful but not required:



Canva

Monday or project management software

Graphic design



Please don’t let a lack of experience in these areas stop you from applying if you believe you’d be a great fit.



Schedule, Pay & Opportunity



Starting Rate: $5 USD/hour



Hours: Approximately 5–15 hours per week to start, depending on workload.



Location: Remote — Philippines



Schedule: Flexible. You do not need to work U.S. business hours, although occasional meetings or check-ins will need to be scheduled.



Trial Period: Paid 30-day trial with weekly check-ins.



Long-Term Opportunity: I’m hoping to build a lasting working relationship. As you learn the businesses and take on more responsibility, there may be opportunities for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and compensation growth.



I’m not looking for someone to complete a few temporary projects. I’m looking for someone who wants to become a valued part of my team.



⸻



HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY!



This part is very important to me!



I’m looking for someone who genuinely wants to work with me and my businesses, not someone who is sending the same generic application to dozens of job postings.



For that reason, I’ve created a personalized application process.



It may take a little more effort than a typical application, but it will help me get to know you and see how you think.



Please complete all three steps below.



STEP 1: Get to Know Me!



Before applying, I’d like you to spend some time learning about who I am and what I do.



Please visit:







Website: studiokinteriors.co



Take some time to explore both businesses.



On Instagram, look through some of my Reels, posts, and recent projects. Pay attention to my style, the types of content I create, and how I communicate with my audience.



I don’t expect you to know everything about me!



I just want to see that you’ve made an effort to understand the businesses you’d be helping with.



STEP 2: Answer These Questions



Please answer the following questions in your own words. You don’t need to write long essays, but I do want thoughtful, specific answers.



1. What are three specific things you noticed about my Instagram content?



These could be things about my design style, the projects I share,  how I communicate, or anything else you noticed.



Please reference actual things you saw rather than giving general compliments.





2. After looking into Studio K Interiors how would you describe my business to someone who’s never heard of it?



What do we sell, who do we serve, and what stood out to you about the business?



3. Imagine I tell you, “I have about 5 drawing projects  I want to work on, but they’re all scattered between my notes,
s, and my head.”



What would you suggest we do to organize everything?



4. After researching my businesses, what is one specific thing you’d be excited to help me with?



Tell me why it interests you?



5. Why are you interested in working with me specifically?



I’d love to hear what genuinely appeals to you about this position and what you’re hoping to learn or accomplish.





STEP 3: Record a Personalized Video Introduction



This is required for all applicants.



Please record a short 1–2 minute video introducing yourself directly to me.



I want it to feel like we’re having our first conversation!



In your video, please:



Start by saying “Hi Kelsey!”

Introduce yourself and briefly tell me about your background.

Mention something specific you learned about me or my businesses while researching.

Explain why you think you’d be a good fit for this role.

Tell me one interesting thing about yourself that isn’t on your resume.



IMPORTANT: This video must be recorded specifically for this application.



Please do not submit a general introduction video that you’ve used for other jobs.



I’m looking for someone who takes the time to personalize their application and follow instructions.



You do not need professional equipment or video editing skills. A simple, clear, genuine video recorded with your phone or computer is perfect.



FINAL APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



Please submit:



Your resume or a brief summary of your relevant experience.

Your answers to all five application questions.

A link to your personalized video introduction (please make sure the link is accessible).

Your available hours per week and your preferred work schedule.

A list of the software and tools you’re comfortable using.



Use this exact subject line:



Studio K Interiors- Interior Design Position — [Your Full Name]



And one final detail:



At the very end of your application, please include this sentence:



“I believe the little details make a big difference.”



This simply helps me see who has carefully read through the entire posting.



Applications that are incomplete or do not follow the instructions may not be considered.



⸻



One Last Thing…



I’m genuinely excited to find the right person!



I’ve built my businesses through a lot of hard work, creativity, and figuring things out as I go.



I’m now at a point where I’d love to have someone helping me behind the scenes so I can continue creating, pursuing new opportunities, and growing.



I value kindness, honesty, initiative, good communication, and people who take pride in their work.



You don’t have to know everything. I don’t expect you to have all the answers.



But I do want someone who is excited to learn, willing to take ownership of their responsibilities, and genuinely interested in what I’m building.



If that sounds like you, I’d love to hear from you!



— Kelsey

title: Hiring a Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
**Hiring a Full-Stack Software Engineer for an Automotive Diagnostic Tool**  

**Pay: $3–$4 USD per hour**



We’re hiring a full-stack software engineer to connect our automotive diagnostic hardware to Android, iPhone, and Windows apps and build the backend that supports them.



We already have the diagnostic algorithms, relevant source code, and working reference tools. You’ll adapt the existing code to our hardware, integrate it with the apps, and test each function against the reference tools.



**What you’ll work on**



- **Device firmware.** Implement the supplied algorithms so our hardware can read vehicle identification numbers (VINs), EEPROM data, and diagnostic trouble codes.

- **Android and iPhone apps.** Connect to the device over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), run diagnostics, display results, and save encrypted backups locally or on the server.

- **Windows desktop software.** Connect to the device over USB-C, run diagnostics, save encrypted backups, and install secure firmware updates.

- **Backend and admin dashboard.** Build the APIs and database for user accounts, device registration by serial number, and server backups. Give administrators a way to view users, manage linked devices, and lock a device when needed.



**Required experience**



- Developing mobile apps that communicate with hardware over BLE.

- Building Windows desktop software that communicates with USB devices.

- Developing authenticated APIs and working with databases.

- Reading existing code, adapting it, and testing the results.



**Bonus skills and willingness to learn**



Experience with CAN bus, OBD-II, UDS, DoIP, secure boot, signed firmware updates, hardware-protected keys, or encrypted storage is a plus. If any of these areas are new to you, you should be willing to learn them and do hands-on firmware integration and testing with our hardware and reference tools.



**To apply**, send one example of a project where you connected hardware to a mobile or Windows app. Tell us what you personally built, how you tested it, your weekly availability, and your hourly rate within the **$3–$4 USD** range.

description:
We're Hiring: Follow-Up Specialist (Real Estate)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Real Estate / Cash Home Buying



About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized, persistent, and relationship-driven Follow-Up Specialist to manage and nurture inbound seller leads.



In this role, you'll take ownership of the lead follow-up process, ensuring every inquiry receives timely attention and no potential opportunity gets lost in the pipeline.



You'll serve as the bridge between inbound leads and the acquisitions team, building meaningful connections with prospective sellers through consistent, personalized, and empathetic communication.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys talking to people, thrives in a high-volume environment, and understands that successful follow-up requires both persistence and genuine relationship-building.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Lead Response & Management

- Contact every new inbound lead within 10 minutes of receiving an inquiry, primarily through phone calls.

- Make multiple contact attempts throughout the day for leads that have not yet been reached.

- Prioritize new inquiries to ensure timely engagement and prevent missed opportunities.

- Record all calls, conversations, and follow-up activities in the CRM.

2. Daily Lead Follow-Up & Campaign Management

- Work through prioritized lead lists daily, following the established urgency and contact cadence.

- Maintain consistent follow-up schedules across different lead stages:

  - Recent leads (0–7 days): 3–5 contact attempts per week.

  - Leads (8–30 days): 2–3 contact attempts per week.

  - Older leads (1–6 months and 6+ months): Maintain regular follow-up campaigns.

- Review and work through missed follow-up tasks at least once every two weeks.

- Alternate between dialer campaigns and click-to-call strategies to maximize contact and answer rates.

3. Relationship Building & Communication

- Build rapport with prospective sellers through genuine, empathetic, and conversational interactions.

- Understand each seller's circumstances, which may include divorce, foreclosure, inherited properties, or financial challenges.

- Personalize conversations based on each lead's situation rather than relying solely on scripted communication.

- Follow up through phone calls, text messages, and
s when prospects are unavailable.

4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records after every interaction, including notes, lead status, and next follow-up dates.

- Track qualified leads successfully passed to the acquisitions team.

- Monitor campaign performance and provide regular updates on lead conversions.

- Identify recurring patterns, opportunities, and challenges, and communicate relevant insights to leadership.



What We're Looking For

- Excellent phone communication skills with a warm, confident, and natural conversational style.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage a high-volume follow-up pipeline.

- High levels of discipline, accountability, and consistency.

- Strong emotional intelligence and empathy when dealing with sellers in sensitive or challenging situations.

- Persistent and proactive, without being overly aggressive or pushy.

- Excellent written communication skills, particularly for personalized text messages and
s.

- Comfortable making a high volume of daily calls.

- Strong attention to detail, especially in CRM documentation and data management.
