title: HOA Manager
description:
The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets.



Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like):



Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs

Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA

Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA

High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications

Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents

Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings



Key Responsibilities:

1) Board & Governance Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings.

Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required.

Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements.

2) Owner & Resident Relations

Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via email, phone, and portal.

Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders).

Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs.

3) Financial Coordination & Reporting 

Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy.

Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies.

Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment.

4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA)

Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections.

Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records.

Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews.

Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents).

5) Information Management & Systems

Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations.

Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules.

Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository.

6) Team Leadership & Development

Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards.

Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings

Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority)

Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected

Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time

Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time

Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate

Qualifications:

3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience

Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills

Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management

Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail

Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: Finance Assistant/Bookholder
description:
The Finance Assistant will be responsible for the reconciliation and management of internal accounts, assist the Assistant Finance Manager with daily accounting tasks such as updating internal system information with new data, communicating important and necessary information to the team, manage and execute daily transactions. The incumbent will also assist in the annual filings, file monthly reconciliations, and maintain electronic files and folders.



Reporting Line:

Day-to-day: Bookholders ? Assistant Finance Manager

Cash Flow, Compliance, Coordination: Bookholders ? Finance Manager

Key Responsibilities:

1. Property Financial Oversight (Reports to Asst FM) 

Manage all financial operations for assigned properties on behalf of the landlord.

Maintain accurate ledgers for rent, fees, expenses, and reserves per property.

Reconcile accounts regularly and ensure completeness and accuracy.



 2. Tenant Accounts & Rent Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Monitor tenant accounts and process rent collections.

Apply payments accurately and handle late payments or delinquencies.

Serve as the first point of contact for tenant financial inquiries.



3. Vendor & Expense Management (Reports to Asst FM) 

Review and approve property-related invoices for Asst FM review.

Track recurring and one-time property expenses.

Ensure timely payment of vendors and compliance with budgets.



4. Reporting (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight) 

Prepare property-specific financial statements (Income, Expenses, Cash Flow, Budget vs. Actual).

Submit reports to Asst FM for consolidation and landlord presentation.

Escalate unusual financial activity to Asst FM, who may involve the FM.



5. Cash Flow Management (Reports to Asst FM, with FM oversight)

Monitor rental cash flow to ensure operating expenses and obligations are covered.

Flag any cash shortages or funding concerns to the FM.

Coordinate landlord distributions with FM approval.





6. Compliance & Documentation (Reports to FM) 

Ensure all financial activities comply with company policy, lease agreements, and regulatory requirements.

Maintain organized records for audits, inspections, and landlord review.

Report compliance concerns directly to FM.



 7. Coordination & Escalation (Reports to FM) 

Collaborate with property managers, maintenance, and other departments for smooth operations.

Escalate complex or cross-departmental financial issues directly to FM.

Support FM in ensuring timely financial decision-making across teams.

Qualifications:

1-2 years of General Accounting experience

Experience with Microsoft Excel, including the ability to understand and manipulate basic spreadsheets

Proficient Accounting and computer skills with the ability to quickly learn new programs

Effective communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely express ideas both verbally and in writing

Ability to display absolute discretion and confidentiality regarding sensitive information

Ability to take initiative to identify, prioritize and implement all elements required for the team to fulfill responsibilities

Ability to work well under pressure and effectively handle multiple, concurrent demands and appropriately prioritize responsibilities

Real Estate experience a plus

Quickbooks experience a plus



































































Key Interview Questions – Finance Assistant / Bookholder

???? Experience & Background

Can you describe the most complex reconciliation you’ve handled? What errors did you find, and how did you resolve them?





Have you ever managed accounts for multiple properties or clients at the same time? How did you stay organized?





What financial systems and tools have you used (QuickBooks, Excel, property management software)? Which one challenged you the most and why?







???? Property Financial Oversight

If you discover that a property’s ledger shows a surplus but the landlord insists there is a deficit, how would you verify the accuracy and explain your findings?





How would you handle a situation where rental income has been misallocated between two properties?





Tell me about a time when you found inconsistencies in property-related financial data. What steps did you take?







???? Tenant Accounts & Rent Management

A tenant claims they already paid rent, but there’s no record in the system. How do you investigate and resolve this?





How do you track and follow up on delinquent accounts without damaging the tenant relationship?





What process do you follow to ensure tenant payment entries are accurate and timely?







???? Vendor & Expense Management

If two invoices come in for the same service but with different amounts, how would you determine which one to process?





What steps do you take to ensure recurring expenses don’t exceed the approved budget?





Have you ever caught an error or overcharge from a vendor? How did you handle it?







???? Reporting & Cash Flow Management

How do you make sure your monthly reports are both accurate and ready on time, especially when you are managing multiple deadlines?





If you identify a cash flow shortfall for a property, what immediate actions would you take before escalating it to the Finance Manager?





What steps do you take to ensure accuracy in budget vs. actual reporting?







???? Compliance & Documentation

How do you make sure financial activities comply with lease agreements and company policies?





If an auditor asks for supporting documentation and you discover missing records, what would be your approach?





Tell me about a time you had to handle sensitive or confidential financial information. How did you protect it?







???? Coordination & Escalation

A property manager pushes you to approve an expense that doesn’t follow policy. What would you do?





How do you balance communication between landlords, tenants, and internal teams when dealing with financial disputes?





Tell me about a time you escalated a financial issue to leadership. What was the outcome?







???? Tools & Technical Skills

Walk me through how you would set up a spreadsheet in Excel to track rent payments for 50+ tenants.





How do you avoid errors when multiple tea
mbers are updating the same QuickBooks or Excel file?





Have you ever suggested or implemented a change to improve financial workflows? What was the impact?







???? Problem-Solving & Judgment

Imagine you discover that monthly reconciliations were skipped for two months. How would you catch up and ensure no errors were missed?





You’re under pressure to close books, but you notice a suspicious transaction. Do you escalate immediately or finish closing first? Why?





What’s the biggest financial mistake you’ve ever made, and how did you correct it?







???? Commitment & Fit

This role requires handling multiple properties/accounts at once. How do you manage time and prioritize when everything feels urgent?





How do you stay calm and accurate when deadlines overlap and you’re under pressure?





What motivates you more: accuracy, deadlines, or recognition? Why?

title: Remote Director of Maintenance
description:
Green Ocean Property Management is a growing property-management organization serving residential rental and condominium/HOA portfolios, supported by related service businesses. Our maintenance operation must deliver fast, reliable service while controlling quality, labor, vendor capacity, billing, and client expectations.

Position Summary

The Maintenance Director is the senior functional leader responsible for maintenance performance across Green Ocean Property Management and Pro Services Boston. Reporting to the COO, this person owns service levels, field-team people management, project and coordination workflows, vendor capacity, department financial performance, and the systems required to deliver consistent work.

This is not primarily a dispatcher, technician, or individual project-manager role. The Director leads the maintenance function through clear scorecards, documented processes, direct management of the field team, and defined responsibilities for the Field Operations Specialist, Project Manager / Estimator, and Maintenance Coordination Team. The right person will make maintenance predictable, profitable, and less dependent on the CEO or COO for daily decisions.

Core Outcomes

Reliable service response: Emergency and routine requests are acknowledged, scheduled, and completed against approved service levels.

Controlled backlog: Every open item has a clear owner, status, next action, and escalation path; aged work is reduced and kept within approved limits.

Profitable maintenance delivery: Labor, vendor cost, billing completeness, project margin, and rework are measured and actively managed.

Consistent field quality: Inspections, workmanship standards, documentation, callbacks, and quality reviews are built into the operating process.

Clear people accountability: Field staff receive direct expectations, coaching, performance follow-up, and capacity planning from the Maintenance Director.

Scalable systems: Intake, coordination, project delivery, field execution, vendor management, and owner/property-manager handoffs are documented and repeatable.

Key Responsibilities

Maintenance Operations Leadership

Own the maintenance operating system from request intake through scheduling, field execution, documentation, billing handoff, and closeout.

Set emergency and routine service levels, escalation rules, quality standards, and communication expectations.

Run weekly maintenance operating reviews covering backlog, aging, scheduled work, emergencies, callbacks, staffing, vendor capacity, and financial performance.

Ensure the Maintenance Coordination Team maintains accurate work-order status, scheduling, resident communication, vendor communication, and after-hours handoffs.

Hold the Project Manager / Estimator accountable for scopes, estimates, schedules, project delivery, change control, documentation, and project margins.

Use the Field Operations Specialist for inspections, technical troubleshooting, difficult jobs, field recommendations, and workmanship checks without assigning people-management duties to that role.

Maintain complete, decision-ready records in PropertyMeld, Buildium, approved trackers, and related source systems.

Field Team and People Leadership

Directly manage field staff, including performance expectations, schedules, coaching, attendance, discipline, development, and staffing decisions.

Define required skills, productivity expectations, quality standards, safety practices, and documentation requirements for each field role.

Build labor and vendor capacity plans that match seasonal demand, portfolio growth, emergency coverage, and project commitments.

Identify performance issues early, document expectations, and complete timely follow-up rather than allowing unresolved problems to move upward to the COO.

Create practical onboarding and training plans for field staff, coordinators, estimators, and vendors.

Maintain a span of control that is workable at current headcount and recommend another frontline leadership seat only when workload and staffing data justify it.

Financial and Vendor Leadership

Own the maintenance budget, labor plan, vendor plan, gross-margin review, billing completeness, and material cost controls.

Ensure all billable labor, materials, vendor costs, estimates, approvals, and change orders are documented and handed to Finance on time.

Review vendor performance, pricing, availability, insurance requirements, service quality, and replacement risk.

Partner with Finance to reconcile operational activity with billing, payroll, vendor bills, receivables, and department reporting.

Identify unprofitable work types, repeated callbacks, underbilling, capacity gaps, and process failures, then bring a corrective recommendation to the COO.

Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as the COO's accountable leader for maintenance outcomes and risks.

Coordinate with Property Operations, Leasing, Customer Success, On Ramp, Finance, and Systems/Data on handoffs that cross departments.

Convert maintenance data into a short executive do-list with an owner, deadline, metric, and expected business effect.

Build and maintain maintenance playbooks for routine work, emergencies, projects, inspections, vendor use, resident communication, and billing handoff.

Identify risks early and bring a recommendation, not only a problem, to the COO and CEO.

Decision Authority and Boundaries

The Maintenance Director is expected to improve routine maintenance processes, manage staff and vendors, enforce approved controls and deadlines, assign work, resolve routine escalations, and make day-to-day operating decisions within approved policies and budgets.

The Director prepares evidence-based recommendations for executive approval on material unbudgeted commitments, senior hires or terminations, major vendor changes, significant pricing or policy changes, legal or safety matters, and other decisions reserved for the COO or CEO. The Director owns maintenance management and results. The role should not depend on personally performing routine field work or redoing coordinator and project-manager tasks.

Proposed Scorecard

Final targets should be confirmed during the first 30 days after reviewing the current baseline.

Emergency and routine service requests meet approved acknowledgment, scheduling, and completion standards.

Aged work orders remain within approved limits, and every material exception has an owner, next action, and date.

Scheduled work, field productivity, project delivery, and vendor capacity are reported weekly.

Billing documentation, labor, material, estimate, approval, and change-order records are complete and timely.

Callbacks, rework, quality defects, safety issues, and repeated failures are measured and reduced against baseline.

Field staff, the Project Manager / Estimator, Field Operations Specialist, and Maintenance Coordination Team deliver their scorecards without the Director redoing their work.

First 90 Days

First 30 Days - Diagnose and Establish Control

Review the maintenance organization, open roles, direct-report capabilities, workload, current vendors, and existing scorecards.

Assess PropertyMeld data, backlog, aging, emergencies, callbacks, projects, estimates, billing handoffs, margin reporting, and field capacity.

Confirm decision rights for the Field Operations Specialist, Project Manager / Estimator, Maintenance Coordination Team, and field staff.

Identify material client, safety, staffing, vendor, financial, and key-person risks.

Agree with the COO on the final scorecard, reporting cadence, approval limits, and escalation rules.

Days 31-60 - Install the Operating Cadence

Launch one weekly maintenance operating review and one monthly financial and capacity review.

Publish service levels, backlog definitions, escalation rules, quality checks, and communication standards.

Implement direct-report scorecards and regular one-on-ones.

Create the field and vendor capacity plan and assign owners to the highest-risk gaps.

Document the required workflow from intake through billing handoff and closeout.

Days 61-90 - Demonstrate Independent Execution

Run a complete maintenance operating cycle without relying on the CEO or COO for daily decisions.

Show measurable movement in aged backlog, scheduling reliability, quality, billing completeness, and team accountability.

Present a 12-month maintenance improvement plan ranked by business impact, risk, effort, cost, and owner.

Demonstrate that field staff and supporting roles operate against clear metrics and decision rights.

Required Qualifications

Significant progressive experience leading maintenance, facilities, construction service, field operations, or a comparable multi-site service function.

Proven people-management experience, including performance expectations, coaching, discipline, hiring, staffing, and direct accountability for a field team.

Working knowledge of work-order operations, emergency response, estimating, project delivery, vendor management, quality control, and safety practices.

Experience owning a department budget, labor capacity, vendor cost, billing completeness, and operating metrics.

Ability to distinguish technical expertise from people leadership and assign each responsibility to the correct role.

Strong written and verbal communication, follow-through, documentation, and comfort holding staff, vendors, and peers accountable.

Experience with property-management, maintenance-management, scheduling, reporting, and collaboration systems.

Ability to lead a distributed team across field and remote functions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in residential property management, condominium/HOA management, multifamily operations, or an in-house maintenance business.

Experience with PropertyMeld, Buildium, QuickBooks Online, Google Workspace, and workflow or reporting automation.

Experience improving response time, backlog aging, gross margin, billing completeness, vendor capacity, callbacks, or field productivity with measurable results.

Relevant trade, construction-management, facilities, project-management, or safety qualification.

Benefits and Time Off

Benefits for this full-time role include:

Health insurance: Employer-sponsored health coverage. Eligibility, plan terms, and the employer contribution are governed by the applicable benefit plan and offer letter.

Paid time off (PTO): 15 paid days annually, subject to company policy.

Paid sick time: 5 paid days annually, subject to company policy and applicable law.

Paid holidays, subject to the company holiday calendar.

Leadership Profile

Leads through clear outcomes rather than constant task supervision.

Creates practical controls without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Uses source data before drawing conclusions and distinguishes urgent work from high-value work.

Solves recurring problems through ownership, process, and systems.

Coaches people while holding a firm performance standard.

Communicates bad news early, plainly, and with a recommended next step.

Equal Opportunity

Green Ocean Property Management is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without unlawful discrimination.



Internal Hiring Note

Because this role directly manages field staff and leads several specialized functions, the hiring process should test people leadership, maintenance operations, financial judgment, vendor management, and the ability to build systems without personally taking over every task. Technical maintenance knowledge without proven people accountability is not sufficient.

Role Performance Metrics

Primary scorecard. Targets are recommended starting points and should be confirmed against the current baseline during the first 30 days.

#

Metric

Target

Measurement source

1

Emergency response control

100% of emergency requests acknowledged within the approved emergency SLA; every missed SLA has a documented cause and corrective action.

PropertyMeld emergency reports and escalation log.

2

Aged backlog control

100% of work older than the approved aging threshold has an owner, next action, and due date; aged backlog improves against the confirmed baseline.

PropertyMeld backlog and aging reports.

3

Schedule reliability

At least 90% of scheduled work is completed by the promised date, excluding documented access, approval, or scope-change delays.

PropertyMeld schedule, completion records, and exception reasons.

4

Billing and margin control

100% of billable labor, materials, vendor costs, approvals, and change orders are documented and submitted on time; department margin is reviewed monthly.

PropertyMeld, time records, vendor bills, Buildium, and finance reporting.

5

Quality and team accountability

Callbacks and rework remain within the approved target; 100% of required scorecards, one-on-ones, reviews, and documented performance follow-ups are completed on time.

Quality reviews, callback log, manager scorecards, and HR records.



Ownership standard: The Director owns these results through field staff, the Project Manager / Estimator, Field Operations Specialist, and Maintenance Coordination Team. Results should reflect independent team performance rather than work the Director personally completed or redid.

title: Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) – Remote
description:
About Us

US Mexico Stem Cell Institute is a regenerative medicine organization that helps patients from the United States and around the world get advanced stem cell therapies. We connect patients with experienced medical professionals and accredited treatment facilities, and we support them from their first inquiry through treatment and follow-up care.

We are a growing, results-driven team that runs on modern systems. Our company uses AI and automation every day for patient engagement, sales, reporting, and decision-making. We are looking for a strategic revenue leader to help us scale, build a high-performing revenue department, and grow how many patients we serve.

Tools and systems we use:

● GoHighLevel (GHL): CRM, pipelines, automations, SMS/email follow-up, and appointment booking

● AI-powered reporting: automated daily, weekly, and monthly dashboards on leads, conversions, revenue, CAC, LTV, and ROAS

● AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT): analysis, forecasting support, scripting, SOPs, and content

● QuickBooks: financial reporting, P&L, and revenue tracking

● Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Sheets): communication, consultation tracking, and collaboration

 

The Role

We're hiring a Chief Revenue Officer to own the company's entire revenue engine: sales, marketing, and revenue operations. You'll report directly to leadership. Your job is to build systems, lead teams, and use data and AI reporting to drive predictable, profitable growth.

Key Responsibilities:

● Set annual, quarterly, and monthly revenue targets and strategy

● Build, recruit, train, and manage sales and marketing teams

● Own pipeline management, lead conversion, patient acquisition, and retention

● Use our AI reporting dashboards to track KPIs, find revenue leaks, and improve conversion rates

● Improve CAC, LTV, ROAS, and revenue per patient

● Create compensation plans, commission structures, and accountability systems

● Develop upselling, cross-selling, and referral programs

● Coordinate across sales, marketing, finance, and operations

● Present clear revenue reports and forecasts to leadership

 

Required Qualifications

Education

● Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field

● CPA

● MBA or advanced business degree is an advantage

● Training in sales leadership, revenue management, digital marketing, or business development is preferred

Experience

● 5–10 years in sales, business development, revenue management, or commercial leadership

● At least 3–5 years in a senior management or leadership role

● Proven track record of increasing revenue and profitability

● Experience managing sales teams, marketing teams, and revenue operations

● Experience working with U.S.-based companies and an understanding of the American market

● Experience building and scaling sales departments and revenue systems

● Experience managing pipelines, customer acquisition, retention, and conversion

Technical Skills

● Expertise in CRMs: GoHighLevel (strongly preferred)

● Strong in sales analytics, KPI monitoring, forecasting, and performance reporting

● Comfortable using AI tools and automated dashboards for reporting and decision-making

● Knowledge of digital marketing, paid advertising, lead generation, and conversion optimization

● Experience with marketing automation,
 marketing, and retention strategies

● Able to analyze financial statements, sales reports, gross margins, and profitability

● Solid understanding of revenue attribution, CAC, LTV, and ROAS

Leadership

● Able to recruit, coach, and manage high-performing sales teams

● Experience setting individual and department targets and holding people accountable

● Experience designing commission plans and sales incentives

● Able to build a revenue department from the ground up

● Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills

Revenue Strategy

● Expert in revenue forecasting and pipeline management

● Able to identify revenue leaks and improve conversion rates

title: Funnel Specialist
description:

Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!

We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands.

title: Operations Manager -- Miami Short-Term Rentals (Hospitable, US Eastern hours)
description:
We have five short- and mid-term rental units in Miami. They already run on Hospitable, HostBuddy AI, Airtable, Slack and Quo, but too many questions and decisions still end up with me. I'm hiring someone to change that.



Most of our stays are mid-term and long-term, so guest messages are light and come mostly around turnovers. The bigger part of the job is coordinating vendors and running the systems.



The same person will build the systems first and then run them.



Phase 1: build (8-10 weeks, about 15 hrs/week)

- Set up Hospitable automated messaging so common guest questions get answered without a person

- Finish and check the HostBuddy AI knowledge base for all five units

- Set up dynamic pricing (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse or Beyond)

- Pull our Airtable into one clean base we can trust

- Write SOPs as you go, clear enough that anyone could follow them for any unit



Phase 2: run (ongoing, 8-10 hrs/week)

You'll run what you built. That means handling guest issues the automations can't, sending vendors out, keeping listings, prices, reservations and calendars up to date. A written document spells out what you d
 on your own, what you d
 and log, and the short list of things you bring to me.



How I'll judge it

Each week, fewer guest messages and operating decisions should reach me, until almost none do.



How we work

If you're not sure, check the source document before you reply. Don't guess on lease terms, pricing or fees. If something is going to be late or wrong, tell me before I find out another way. When you bring me a problem, bring your recommendation and a deadline with it. Nothing a guest can see changes without my written OK.



You're a good fit if

You've automated a rental operation yourself. You've set up a PMS (Hospitable, Guesty, Hostaway or similar), a dynamic pricing tool, and AI or template guest messaging. You're comfortable in Airtable or something like it, and you write things down as you work.



Hours and coverage

HostBuddy and Hospitable answer guests first. Anything they can't handle comes to you. You or your team need to reply within 30 minutes, 8 AM to 10 PM Eastern (9 PM to 11 AM Philippine time), every day, with an on-call number for overnight emergencies like lockouts or leaks. I get a weekly summary and hear from you only about urgent issues. You'll also need a way to make US phone calls, and spoken English that guests and vendors can follow easily.



Pay

$5-13/hr depending on experience, tracked in Hubstaff (with screenshots) and paid monthly. Everyone starts with a paid two-week trial doing real work. If you have a team, each person who works on our account tracks their time in Hubstaff too.



To apply

Start your application with the word OASIS. Tell me which PMS, pricing tool and guest-messaging system you've set up yourself, and how you or your team would cover 8 AM to 10 PM Eastern every day.

title: Part-Time Referral Outreach & Admin Assistant (20 hrs/week) for US Therapy Practice
description:
About us

New Birth Family Counseling is a private-pay, integrative therapy practice in San Diego, California, led by Dr. Regina Ransom, a Navy veteran with two doctorates. We offer individual, couples, child and family therapy, plus our signature in-person couples intensives that couples now fly in from other states to attend. We are growing fast, and we need a reliable, warm, detail-oriented assistant to help us build relationships with referral partners and keep our marketing and admin running smoothly.



This is a long-term role with room to grow into full-time as we grow.



What you will do

1. Referral outreach (your main job)

- Research and build contact lists of San Diego referral partners: concierge and integrative doctors, OB-GYN and menopause practices, pediatricians, family law attorneys, churches, schools, and military family programs

- Call,
, and fax offices from our approved scripts and templates, introducing our practice on behalf of Dr. Ransom

- Follow up on a set schedule (for example, 1 week and 3 weeks after first contact)

- Book short intro calls or visits on Dr. Ransom's calendar with offices that are interested

- Keep every contact and follow-up date updated in our Google Sheets tracker



2. Directory listings and online presence

- Create and update our practice and clinician profiles on online directories

- Find and fix old or incorrect listings (wrong phone numbers, old names)



3. Marketing and admin support

- Help publish blog posts and simple updates on our Squarespace website

- Prepare monthly
 newsletters for our community events

- Help with logistics for our couples intensives (vendor confirmations, schedules, reminders)

- Simple research tasks as needed



Important: this role does not involve client health information at the start. Any future client-facing work would only come after HIPAA training and a signed confidentiality agreement.



Who we are looking for

- Excellent written and spoken English, warm and professional on the phone

- Experience with cold calling, outreach, or appointment setting (healthcare or US clients is a big plus)

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Gmail, and Google Calendar; Squarespace or Canva is a plus

- Organized, follows written instructions carefully, and follows through without reminders

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace, and a headset for calls



Hours and pay

- Part-time, about 20 hours per week (4 hours a day, Monday to Friday)

- At least 2 hours per day must overlap with US Pacific business hours (9am to 5pm Pacific) for phone calls

- $450 to $500 per month depending on experience, paid twice monthly

- Long-term role with the opportunity to grow into full-time



How to apply

Please send:

1. A short introduction and your relevant experience

2. Your monthly rate and the hours you are available (in Pacific time)

3. Test task: Write a friendly 3 to 4 sentence
 introducing our counseling practice to a family doctor's office manager in San Diego, and asking if you may send a one-page information sheet for their providers.

4. Start your message with the words "Rooted and ready" so we know you read the full post.



Applications without the test task will not be considered. Please write your answers yourself. We value honesty over polish.

title: Accounting Associate
description:
Accounting Specialist – Payroll & General Accounting



Job Summary



US In Home Services is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and experienced Accounting Specialist to support our finance and accounting operations, with a primary focus on payroll processing and general accounting functions.



The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing, reviewing employee time records, calculating wages and deductions, maintaining payroll documentation, and assisting with various accounting activities, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, and financial reporting.



This position requires a strong understanding of accounting principles, payroll procedures, financial documentation, and confidentiality when handling sensitive employee and company financial information.



The ideal candidate must be dependable, analytical, highly organized, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced remote environment while meeting deadlines and maintaining accuracy.



Key Responsibilities



1. Payroll Processing and Administration



Prepare, review, and process employee payroll accurately and within established payroll schedules.



Review employee timesheets, attendance records, working hours, overtime, leave deductions, and other payroll adjustments.



Verify employee compensation, hourly rates, salary arrangements, bonuses, incentives, and applicable deductions.



Coordinate with HR and department managers to verify new hires, resignations, terminations, promotions, salary adjustments, and other employment-related changes affecting payroll.



Identify and investigate payroll discrepancies, incorrect time entries, missing hours, and payment inconsistencies.



Maintain accurate payroll records, employee compensation details, and supporting documentation.



Prepare payroll summaries and reports for management and accounting review.



Ensure payroll information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable company policies and regulations.



Assist in reconciling payroll records against accounting records and payment reports.



Coordinate with management and HR to resolve payroll-related concerns and discrepancies.



2. General Accounting Functions



Maintain accurate financial records, general ledger entries, and supporting accounting documentation.



Prepare journal entries and perform account reconciliations.



Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice verification, payment tracking, and transaction recording.



Perform bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies between bank statements and internal financial records.



Monitor company expenses, transactions, and financial activities.



Assist in preparing monthly financial statements, income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.



Maintain organized financial records and ensure proper documentation of accounting transactions.



3. Financial Reporting and Compliance



Prepare regular payroll and accounting reports for management.



Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.



Review financial transactions to ensure accuracy and completeness.



Support internal and external audits by providing requested financial records and documentation.



Assist in monitoring compliance with applicable accounting, payroll, and tax requirements.



Identify opportunities to improve payroll procedures, accounting workflows, and financial reporting processes.



4. Coordination and Administrative Support



Work closely with HR, management, and other departments to ensure accurate employee payroll information.



Communicate payroll discrepancies and accounting concerns to the appropriate personnel.



Maintain proper documentation of payroll and accounting procedures.



Recommend improvements to existing accounting processes to increase efficiency and accuracy.



Perform other accounting-related duties as assigned by management.



Required Qualifications and Skills



Proven experience in accounting, bookkeeping, payroll processing, or a related finance position.



Strong understanding of accounting principles, including debits and credits, double-entry bookkeeping, accrual accounting, and journal entries.



Hands-on experience with payroll preparation, timekeeping, wage calculations, and payroll reconciliation.



Knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and bank reconciliation.



Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, data organization, and financial reporting.



Experience using accounting or payroll software is highly preferred.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial information.



Ability to maintain confidentiality when dealing with employee compensation and sensitive financial records.



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Ability to meet strict payroll deadlines and manage multiple accounting responsibilities.



Good written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to work independently and collaborate with a remote team.



Company Overview



US In Home Services is a home appliance service company providing professional in-home appliance repair solutions.



We are a for-profit corporation registered in Georgia, Tennessee, Alabama, Florida, North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, Mississippi, Louisiana, Missouri, and Arkansas, with continued expansion into additional markets.



Our company provides appliance repair services to major manufacturers and extended warranty providers, including Samsung, LG, GE, Electrolux, Hisense, Midea, AIG, Assurant, Asurion, and Allstate.



Our services cover a wide range of household appliances, including washing machines, dryers, ovens, cooktops, refrigerators, microwaves, and coffee machines.



We value a workplace culture that is:



Detail-oriented: Focused on accuracy, quality, and accountability.



People-oriented: Committed to supporting employees and maintaining fairness.



Team-oriented: Encouraging collaboration, communication, and continuous improvement.



For more information, visit: 



Employment Requirements



Employment Type: Full-Time



Work Schedule: Monday–Friday



Work Location: Remote – Philippines



Fluent English communication skills.



Reliable internet connection and a suitable work-from-home environment.



Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.



Willingness to learn company-specific accounting and payroll procedures.



Paid training will be provided by US In Home Services.



Experience



At least 2–3 years of relevant accounting, bookkeeping, or payroll experience is preferred.



Previous experience handling payroll for multiple employees is a strong advantage.



Experience with US-based companies, US payroll procedures, or international payroll operations is highly preferred.



Familiarity with accounting software, payroll systems, and spreadsheet-based financial reporting is an advantage.



Language

Property Lead Generation & Viewing Booker (Part-Time, UK Property)



We’re a London-based letting business with 700+ properties to fill: rooms, studios, 1-beds, 2-beds, 3-beds and larger. Most are in London, with others in cities across the UK. We need a creative, self-driven lead generator to bring in qualified tenants and book them in for viewings.



What you’ll do



Find and attract tenants through non-traditional channels. Rightmove, Zoopla, OpenRent and SpareRoom are already covered by other agents, so we want fresh sources and creative approaches.

Qualify leads before booking (budget, move-in date, requirements, suitability).

Book as many qualified viewings as possible across our available properties.

Hit a monthly viewing target (agreed at the start).

Set up and use AI and automation so every tenant inquiry gets a reply within 5 minutes, even when you’re offline.



What we’re looking for



Proven experience in property, tenant finding, or lead generation (qualified leads, not just volume).

A creative thinker who can find tenants where other agents aren’t looking.

Strong with AI tools and automation (chatbots, auto-responders, CRM or workflow tools such as Zapier or Make).

Excellent written English and a professional, friendly communication style.

Reliable, organised and results-driven.



Hours



Part-time, around 20 hours per week.

Must be available between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM UK time (London). Some flexibility is possible for highly experienced candidates.



Pay



Starting at $275 per month, with room to grow.

Fixed, uncapped commission: $200 per room let and $250 per apartment let.

Paid 1-month trial, then a permanent position based on performance.



Support

I’ll help you prioritise the properties that are easiest and most profitable to let, based on my experience in the market, so you can focus your effort where it counts.



To apply, please include:



Your relevant experience in property, tenant finding or lead generation

Examples of creative methods you’ve used to generate leads

The AI or automation tools you’ve worked with

Your availability for the 10 AM to 5 PM UK window

Your expected pay



Start your application with the word “VIEWINGS” AND use 10 AP so I know you’ve read the full post.

title: Nominee Director and Shareholder
description:
Very easy task - I need someone to hold my shares in the company I created.



I want to leave the company I founded, but the shareholders won't let me leave as they need a Director. I want someone to buy my shares in the company for $1 and I'll pay them $180 to do it. You don't need to do anything with the company afterwards if you don't want to - that's up to you.



How it works:

I'll draw up a contract selling you my shares (51%) of the company for $1.

You'll need to prove your ID with UK Companies House to get a "Personal Code": 

NOTE: You will need a biometric passport for this bit.

I'll transfer you $10, you send me $1 back to buy my shares. I then send you another $171 to thank you for your help.

You'll then own the shares - you can sell them, or just forget about them, I don't mind - I just want to leave.

There's no debt on the company, so it can be closed.

I'll send you everything you need to run the company if you want. It was a large agency and still has great potential.

title: Power BI Virtual Assistant
description:
Who We Are:

Native Pest Management is a local, family-owned business providing pet-friendly and environmentally responsible pest control services across Florida. We take pride in using safe, ethical practices and go above and beyond to exceed customer expectations every day.



We are proud to have earned a place on the Inc. 5000 List of the Fastest Growing Companies in the United States from 2021 to 2025, as well as the 2021 Better Business Bureau Torch Award for Ethics. These recognitions reflect our commitment to quality and integrity in everything we do. Additional recognitions include:



Recognized in the PCT Top 100 as one of the largest and fastest-growing pest control companies in North America

Named to the Gator100 List of fastest-growing Gator-led companies four years in a row, ranking No. 24 in 2025

Ranked #1 Pest Control Company in Florida by Top Rated Local™ based on more than 10,000 five-star reviews

Winner of the 2023 FLCAJ Readers’ Choice Platinum Award for pest control services



Your Opportunity:

We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-oriented, and tech-savvy Power BI Virtual Assistant (VA) to support our team by collecting, organizing, and interpreting data to drive informed decision-making. In this role, you will work with various data sources, identify trends, and generate actionable insights to improve business performance and efficiency.



The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, experience with data visualization tools, and the ability to communicate findings effectively. This position requires proficiency in data management, reporting, and problem-solving, along with a keen eye for accuracy and trends. You will collaborate closely with leadership, including the Owner, VP of Internal Operations, and VP of External Operations, to provide data-driven recommendations and enhance strategic initiatives. Fluency in spoken and written English with little to no grammatical errors is required for effective communication. The role may also involve video meetings for training, progress updates, and performance discussions.



Qualifications:

Proficiency in Power BI, including DAX, data modeling, and report building

Proficiency in Google Sheets for data manipulation

Strong understanding of data processing, validation, and integration

Ability to evaluate and onboard new software solutions

Experience using API connections to build integrations between software

Please include the word wizard in your subject line when applying if reading this

Experience diagnosing and resolving data-related issues

Experience optimizing workflows for efficiency and accuracy

Experience with SQL



Key Responsibilities:

-Power BI-

Create, update, and maintain Power BI reports

Assist in extracting, transforming, and loading data from multiple sources

Assist in data modeling, DAX calculations, and report optimizations

Automate data refreshes and troubleshoot issues as they arise



Software Implementation & Integration:

• Assist in evaluating, implementing, and integrating new software solutions

• Configure tools and ensure seamless integration with existing platforms

• Support the creation of training materials and documentation for new systems as needed



Data Management & Reporting:

• Ensure data integrity and consistency across all platforms

• Generate and maintain reports, dashboards, and ad-hoc data analyses

• Provide actionable insights to leadership based on data trends and performance metrics



Perks:

13th-month bonus

10 days of paid time off (PTO) during the first year

6 US Holidays

Competitive starting salary



Specifics:

Full-time role (40 hours per week)

Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM EDT/EST (GMT-5), including a 1-hour unpaid lunch break



Must have:

Strong high-speed Wi-Fi

Good microphone

Good camera

Organized and professional work from home setup



Application Requirement:

This role requires exceptional English language proficiency, including clear pronunciation and strong conversational skills, to ensure clear, confident, and professional communication. Applicants must submit a 2–3 minute video recording (or video link) speaking in English, which may be a brief introduction or a short sample conversation highlighting relevant experience and skills. Applications submitted without a video will not be considered. Applicants must also submit a resume or portfolio and a brief cover message. Incomplete applications or applications that do not follow instructions will not be considered.



Why Native Pest Management:

At Native Pest Management, we focus on creating long-term careers for our employees with clear paths for growth. Our goal is to become the largest privately held pest control company in Florida, which will continue to open doors for advancement.

With over 10,000 five-star reviews across platforms like Google, Yelp, and Angie’s List, our team takes pride in delivering exceptional service that keeps customers coming back and referring us to others. That reputation is a direct reflection of the hard work and professionalism of our staff.



The pest management industry is rapidly expanding and offers a recession-resistant career path.

We are committed to providing valuable, comprehensive, and affordable benefits to our employees. Each year, we review our programs to ensure they continue to meet these goals and support our team’s evolving needs. We’re committed to your success now and in the future.



This role requires exceptional English language proficiency, with precise pronunciation and highly effective conversational skills, to ensure clear, confident, and professional communication with team members.



What to Expect During the Hiring Process:

Once you submit your application, our HR team may reach out for an initial phone or Zoom interview. Candidates who move forward may then be invited to an additional follow-up interview, via Zoom or GoogleMeet. Applicants must submit a 2–3 minute video recording (or video link) speaking in English. Please introduce yourself and briefly discuss your relevant work experience and skills. We encourage you to speak naturally and conversationally rather than reading from a script, as this helps us better understand your communication style in real-world work situations. Light notes or bullet points are fine, but avoid reading word-for-word. Applications submitted without a video link will not be considered. The application process involves a review, and selected candidates may be invited for a screening or interview, which may include a typing test. Applicants unwilling to participate in an interview need not apply. Incomplete applications or those not following instructions will not be considered.



Background Check Statement:

Employment is contingent upon successfully completing a background check, which may include a criminal history verification or equivalent clearance based on the applicant’s country of residence. Any required documentation must be completed within two (2) weeks of the start date.



Native Pest Management is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, or any other status protected by federal or Florida law.

title: Technical Account Engineer (MSP) – Infrastructure, Cloud & Projects
description:
We are seeking a consultative and technically proficient Technical Account Engineer (MSP) to serve as the primary technical advisor and relationship lead for a portfolio of business clients.



Are you an experienced IT systems engineer or solutions consultant who thrives at the intersection of architecture, project execution, and strategic client advisory? If you enjoy translating complex business challenges into resilient cloud and infrastructure designs, driving end-to-end project cutovers, and serving as the trusted technical authority for business leaders, this role was built for you.



We bridge the gap between high-level consulting and real-world engineering. As our Technical Account Engineer (MSP), you will oversee the full lifecycle of client technology: from initial discovery, solution design, and SOW scoping, to hands-on project delivery, ongoing infrastructure roadmap reviews, and high-level escalation engineering. We back our team with direct leadership mentorship, company-paid certifications, and a culture that values engineering craftsmanship and ownership.



Key Responsibilities



1. Client Discovery & Pre-Sales Engineering



* Technical Discovery & Audits: Lead deep-dive architectural assessments to uncover client infrastructure bottlenecks, security gaps, and technical requirements.

* Solution Architecture: Design practical and secure solutions across Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, hybrid networking, cybersecurity, disaster recovery, and virtualization.

* Scoping & Effort Estimation: Prepare accurate technical scopes, architectural diagrams, work breakdown structures, and resource/effort estimates for Statements of Work (SOWs).

* Client Presentations & Demos: Partner with Account Managers to present technical solutions, explain business ROI, and address client technical concerns.

* Sales Handoff: Own the formal technical handoff from sales into engineering delivery to guarantee scope fidelity and eliminate assumptions.



2. Strategic Technical Account Management



* Trusted Advisory: Act as the primary technical advisor for an assigned portfolio of US business clients.

* Health Reviews & Roadmapping: Conduct annual IT assessments, evaluating cloud security posture, hardware lifecycles, system performance, and more.

* Proactive Gap Remediation: Analyze recurring operational tickets to diagnose chronic IT issues, proposing technical solutions rather than temporary workarounds.

* Escalated Consultation: Advise clients and support teammates through urgent technical dilemmas, compliance changes, disaster scenarios, and business expansion needs.



3. Escalation & Support Engineering (L2/L3)



* High-Severity Troubleshooting: Serve as the escalation point for critical issues and complex infrastructure i
.

* Technical Mentorship: Provide root-cause guidance and technical coaching to frontline support technicians.

* Remediation Plans: Engineer and deploy long-term technical remediation plans for root-cause issues uncovered during major i
.

* Knowledge Management: Author, review, and curate internal knowledge base articles, standard operating guides, and technical baselines.



What We Are Looking For



* Relevant Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on systems administration, technical account management, or solutions engineering experience, with solid exposure to Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments.

* Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure: Deep working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, Azure Virtual Desktop/IaaS, Windows Server environments, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, and Group Policy.

title: DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist - PH based
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands. 



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

* **TheraOffice experience is strongly preferred**

* Outpatient physical therapy experience

* Experience with Medicare and Medicare Advantage plans

* Experience with Humana, UnitedHealthcare, Cigna, Aetna, BCBS, WellCare, Medicaid, VA, and similar payers

* Experience with Availity and other insurance portals

* Experience obtaining authorizations for physical therapy

* Experience faxing and tracking Plans of Care and physician signatures

What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will independently manage the administrative process from beginning to end:



**VERIFY → AUTHORIZE → MONITOR → OBTAIN DOCUMENTATION → SEND → FOLLOW UP → RECEIVE → UPLOAD → CLOSE**



Our goal is for patients to receive treatment without preventable interruptions caused by missing insurance verification, expired authorizations, incomplete documentation, or unsigned Plans of Care.



## Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is proactive and does not wait for problems to occur.



You should be the type of person who notices that a patient has only two authorized visits remaining and begins working on the next authorization **before** the patient runs out.



You should be comfortable taking ownership of your assigned patients, following up repeatedly when necessary, and making sure tasks are completely resolved.



**This position is best suited for someone with prior authorization experience who can work independently with minimal day-to-day supervision.**





Please submit your resume and include a brief description of your experience with:



* Prior authorizations

* Insurance verification

* Physical therapy or outpatient rehabilitation

* TheraOffice, if applicable

* Insurance payer portals

title: UGC Creator & Influencer Coordinator
description:
About the Opportunity



What if the creators you recruit today become the faces behind our next winning advertisements?

At Enclave BioActives, we're looking for a driven and resourceful UGC Creator & Influencer Coordinator who wants to do more than manage creator collaborations. We want someone who can build a powerful creator network, bring fresh creative talent into our brands, and help fuel the growth of our marketing campaigns.

As we continue expanding our brands, we need a consistent pipeline of talented creators who can produce authentic, engaging, and conversion-focused content. That's where you come in.

You will take ownership of the creator acquisition and management process—from discovering promising talent and building relationships to coordinating content production and securing advertising permissions.

If you're someone who loves building relationships, making things happen, and seeing the direct results of your work, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.



What You'll Bring



Proven experience recruiting and managing UGC creators and/or influencers for consumer brands.

Hands-on experience with TRIBE, Insense, or similar creator recruitment platforms and marketplaces.

Strong understanding of the complete UGC workflow, from sourcing and outreach to briefing, production, revisions, and final delivery.

Experience coordinating Meta whitelisting, Partnership Ads, and creator-authorized paid advertising.

Experience recruiting or managing TikTok Shop creators and affiliates.

A strong eye for identifying creators who can produce authentic, engaging, and compelling direct-response content.

Excellent communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

Ability to manage multiple creators, collaborations, and content projects without losing track of priorities.

Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently drive projects forward.

A proactive, ownership-driven attitude with a genuine interest in creative performance and marketing.



How You'll Make an Impact

Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified creators for continuous content production.

Your impact: Build a dependable creator ecosystem that gives our brands continuous access to fresh talent and creative opportunities.



2. Turn Creator Partnerships Into High-Quality Content

Manage the end-to-end creator collaboration process, from initial outreach and recruitment to final content delivery.

Coordinate creative briefs, product shipments, deadlines, revisions, approvals, and deliverables.

Evaluate creators based on content quality, authenticity, communication, audience fit, and potential to produce effective advertising assets.

Negotiate creator rates, deliverables, usage rights, and collaboration terms.

Maintain strong relationships that encourage repeat collaborations and consistent content production.

Your impact: Ensure our creative team receives a steady supply of quality UGC without unnecessary delays or production bottlenecks.



3. Help Power Our Winning Advertising Creatives

Collaborate with Creative Strategists and Media Buyers to understand the creators, content styles, and messaging angles needed for upcoming campaigns.

Source creators who can effectively communicate product benefits, address customer pain points, and create compelling content.

Support the production of creator-led advertisements designed for creative testing and paid media campaigns.

Coordinate Meta whitelisting and Partnership Ads, ensuring all necessary creator authorizations are secured.

Recruit and manage TikTok Shop creators and affiliates to support creator-led content and affiliate initiatives.

Your impact: Help our team test more creative concepts, explore new advertising opportunities, and develop content with the potential to become winning ads.



4. Protect Our Brand and Creator Partnerships

Negotiate creator compensation, deliverables, usage rights, and advertising permissions.

Secure the necessary content usage rights and creator authorizations before assets are used in campaigns.

Coordinate creator agreements and ensure collaboration terms are clearly documented.

Your impact: Give our team confidence that the content we produce is properly authorized and ready for marketing use.



5. Build Systems That Can Scale With the Business

Identify opportunities to improve creator sourcing, outreach, onboarding, and production workflows.

Track recruitment activity, creator responsiveness, content delivery, and relevant campaign indicators.

Identify high-quality creators who are worth developing into long-term brand partners.

Continuously improve the creator pipeline to support increasing creative production demands across our brands.

Your impact: Help transform creator recruitment from a series of individual collaborations into a repeatable, scalable growth system.



Why Join Enclave BioActives?



Make an Impact That Goes Beyond Your Job Title.

Own Something Meaningful: Take the lead in building and developing a creator network that becomes an important asset to our business.

See the Results of Your Work: Your recruitment efforts will directly contribute to the creative content our brands use to reach and convert customers.



Who Will Thrive in This Role?



This opportunity is ideal for someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do.

You enjoy finding great talent, building relationships, negotiating partnerships, and making sure projects get done. You understand that great UGC can be more than engaging content—it can become a powerful advertising asset that helps a business grow.



We're not simply looking for someone to coordinate creators. We're looking for someone who can build the creator network, systems, and partnerships that help drive our next stage of growth.
