title: Remote Appointment Setter / Lead Conversion Specialist
description:
About Us



Liverpool Chiropractic Clinic is a busy, growing multidisciplinary healthcare clinic based in Liverpool, United Kingdom.



We specialise in chiropractic care, IDD spinal decompression therapy, physiotherapy and sports rehabilitation.



We are looking for a confident, friendly and motivated Remote Appointment Setter to join our team and help convert incoming
 and Instagram 
 into booked appointments.



This is not a cold-calling position. You will be contacting people who have already expressed an interest in our services by submitting their details through our advertising campaigns.



The Role



Your main responsibility will be to contact potential patients who have enquired about our specialist IDD Therapy service, qualify their enquiries using a simple screening process and help them book and pay for their initial appointments.



Some enquiries may be more appropriate for our chiropractic service, so you will also be trained to explain and book our alternative new patient offers.



We will provide full training, telephone scripts and clear step-by-step procedures.



Key Responsibilities



Contact new leads generated through
 and Instagram advertising.



Make outbound telephone calls using GoHighLevel.



Monitor new enquiries through Google Sheets and GoHighLevel Opportunities.



Follow a structured telephone follow-up process for leads who haven't answered.



Build rapport and communicate professionally with prospective patients.



Ask a series of simple screening questions to help identify the appropriate appointment pathway.



Explain our IDD Therapy assessment package, pricing and booking process.



Answer common questions using approved scripts and training materials.



Book new patient appointments directly into our ZonEee booking system.



Send secure Stripe payment links to patients while speaking with them.



Follow up with patients who have expressed interest but have not booked.



Maintain accurate records of calls, lead statuses, appointments and payments.



Provide a simple daily report of activity and booking results.



What We're Looking For



Essential Requirements:



Excellent spoken and written English.



Clear, confident and professional telephone communication.



Previous experience in appointment setting, lead conversion, telesales or customer service.



Comfortable making outbound telephone calls throughout your shift.



Friendly, empathetic and patient when speaking to potential customers.



Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.



Reliable internet connection, computer and quiet working environment.



Ability to follow structured processes and work independently.



Reliable availability during agreed UK working hours.



Desirable Experience:



Experience speaking with UK customers.



Previous appointment-setting experience in healthcare, chiropractic, physiotherapy or similar services.



Experience using GoHighLevel or other CRM systems.



Familiarity with Stripe, Google Sheets or appointment booking software.



Experience converting
 or Instagram leads into appointments.



Healthcare experience is helpful but not essential. Full training will be provided.



Working Hours



Initially, approximately 10 hours per week, working Monday to Friday.



The role will involve two short shifts per day, one during the UK morning and another during the UK afternoon.



This is to allow us to contact leads at different times throughout the day.



There is potential for additional hours as the role and business grow.



Pay and Bonuses



Starting hourly rate: $5 per hour.



Performance bonus: $4 for each successfully booked and paid appointment that attends the clinic.



Initial two-week paid trial period.



Potential for increased hours and progression based on performance.



Training and Support



We will provide:



Full training on our clinic and services.



A structured telephone script.



A simple five-question lead screening process.



Training on our offers, pricing and frequently asked questions.



Step-by-step instructions for GoHighLevel, Stripe, Google Sheets and ZonEee.



A structured lead follow-up process.



Regular feedback and support from our UK team.



You will not be expected to provide medical advice or make clinical decisions.



What Success Looks Like



We are looking for someone who:



Responds promptly to new enquiries.



Is confident and natural on the telephone.



Consistently follows up with leads.



Converts suitable enquiries into paid appointments.



Keeps accurate records and follows procedures.



Works reliably with minimal supervision.



Represents our clinic in a friendly and professional manner.



Our goal is to find someone who can become a reliable long-term member of our team.



How to Apply



Please send us:



Your CV or summary of relevant work experience.



A short introduction explaining your previous appointment-setting or telephone sales experience.



A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this role.



Your availability to work split shifts during UK business hours.



Details of any experience using GoHighLevel or similar CRM systems.



Important: Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



We are particularly interested in candidates who communicate naturally, speak excellent English and are comfortable building relationships over the telephone.



We look forward to hearing from you!



Liverpool Chiropractic Clinic

title: Bookkeeper (Remote – UK Accounting Firm)
description:
How to Apply

Apply via the link below: 



Essential Qualifications

- CPA qualified (Philippine CPA licence) OR ACCA or equivalent

- 2+ years’ bookkeeping or accounting experience after qualifying, including month-end closes for multiple clients.

- 2+ years’ hands-on Xero experience.

- Strong working knowledge of accruals, prepayments, stock, balance sheet reconciliations and journals.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with experience communicating directly with clients.

- A stable work history and references we can speak to.

- Reliable home setup and availability for UK hours.

- Accounting practice or outsourced-accounting background.



The Role: Bookkeeper

- You’ll own the day-to-day bookkeeping for a portfolio of 12 to 15 UK clients in Xero and hand each file to your Reviewer complete, reconciled and ready to sign off. Your Reviewer’s job is to check that the accounts make sense. Your job is to make sure there is nothing left for them to fix.

- You’ll be productive from your first week. We need someone who does the transactional work quickly and accurately, solves bookkeeping problems themselves, and deals with clients directly to get what is missing.

- Expect to turn work around in days, to juggle several clients in the same day, and to tell us early when a deadline is at risk.

- You’ll get client-specific context and feedback from your Reviewer, and you’ll be trusted to run your own workload.



This role suits someone who enjoys a busy desk and takes pride in clearing it. If you prefer a slower pace or a narrow set of repeat tasks, it will be a poor fit.



Key Responsibilities

- Weekly and monthly bookkeeping in Xero and Dext: bank, credit card and payment-platform reconciliations (Stripe, Shopify, PayPal), purchase and sales invoice processing, and accurate coding including tracking categories.

- Month-end close for each client: accruals, prepayments, stock and other journals, balance sheet reconciliations, and a file with every open item explained.

- Bookkeeping notes and document requests sent to clients on schedule, and followed up by
, Slack or WhatsApp until they are answered.

- VAT preparation: the underlying bookkeeping complete and correctly treated before the return is drafted for review.

- Client-specific rules and processes applied consistently, and documented where they don’t exist yet.

- A short written daily update on what was completed, what is planned and what is blocked, with work items and timesheets kept up to date in our project management system.



What Good Looks Like

- Work reaches review complete, and review comments reduce month on month.

- Deadlines are met without anyone chasing you.

- Clients get clear, professional requests and reply to them.

- Problems are raised the day you find them, with what you need to close them.

- You can explain any balance on a balance sheet you have closed.



Nice to Have

- Experience with UK clients and UK VAT.

- Xero Advisor certification.

- Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis and journals.



Working Hours

- UK hours: 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM PH time, Monday to Friday (with breaks).



What You’ll Get

- Salary: ₱60,000 per month, depending on experience.

- 20 days paid leave plus Philippine holidays.

- Fully remote, long-term role with a stable client portfolio.

- A dedicated Reviewer and direct access to the firm’s Partner.

- Progression to Reviewer / pod lead for high performers.



About Sidekick



Sidekick is a UK Chartered Accountancy firm (ICAEW regulated) providing accounting and tax advisory to founder-led businesses. Our clients are growing quickly and they rely on up-to-date numbers to make decisions, so we work to weekly bookkeeping cycles, month-end closes inside the first two weeks of the month, and fixed VAT and reporting deadlines.

We are a small, senior team and the pace is fast. Every person carries a full portfolio, priorities move during the week as client information lands, and several deadlines usually run at the same time. Each pod is a Reviewer and a Bookkeeper who together own their clients from the first transaction through to the month-end close.



We’re hiring an experienced, CPA-qualified Bookkeeper to run the bookkeeping for one of those pods. This is a fully remote, home-based, long-term role.



How to Apply

Apply via the link below: 



In your application, tell us your CPA licence year, how long you have used Xero, and how many clients you closed each month in your last role.



The process is a short practical Xero test, an interview with the Partner, and reference checks with previous employers.

 We will auto-reject if: no CPA license, under 2 years’ experience, or no hands-on Xero experience.

s, chats, or support tickets.

title: B2B Cold Caller — U.S. Web Design Company ($3/hr + $20 Per Customer Who Buys)

Call small businesses across the United States from our lead lists. Using our script, you'll offer the business a FREE personalized demo website built with their actual business name, phone number, and services — no selling, no closing, no collecting payments.

Their best
 address

The name of the person you spoke with

title: Sr. Full-Stack AI & WordPress Engineer: $10-$12/hr (RAG Pipelines, Elementor JSON Schemas, Multi-Tenant Architecture)

We value practical expertise over theoretical knowledge. Show us what you have actually built, how you think, and what you can bring to the team.



In your submission, please also provide:

1. GitHub or Live Production Samples: Share 2–3 links showcasing backend code, custom WordPress REST API plugins, or programmatic JSON generators you have built.

5. And your updated resume.



(Applications who didn't provide the information requested above will be disqualified immediately.)



Regards,



Phong (Peter) Nguyen.

title: Staff Accountant
description:
Fully Remote Staff Accountant and US Payroll Specialist 



Full-time independent contractor | Monthly contractor compensation based on experience 



About Sound Solution Group 



Sound Solution Group is a family-owned commercial acoustics, sound masking, and noise control company serving the Western United States. We specialize in low-voltage systems and construction-related projects. 



Position Summary 



We are seeking a remote based accounting professional with hands-on US construction payroll experience. The role is approximately 50% weekly payroll administration and 50% staff accounting, supporting payroll for approximately 20 employees. You will use QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Online Payroll, review management-approved time and job information from Salesforce, and support accurate accounting records, job costing, and month-end close. Approximately one-quarter of projects may require prevailing-wage compliance. 



Weekly Payroll and Construction Reporting 



Prepare and process weekly US payroll through QuickBooks Online Payroll within established deadlines and approval procedures. 

Review management-approved time records from Salesforce; validate employee hours, pay rates, job codes, work locations, deductions, reimbursements, and approved changes. Resolve or escalate exceptions before submission. 

Apply applicable construction payroll requirements, including prevailing-wage rates, employee classifications, fringe benefits, and certified payroll reporting. Confirm project requirements and escalate missing information. 

Allocate payroll labor accurately by employee and job, and reconcile timekeeping data, payroll registers, job-cost reports, and general ledger postings. 

Prepare payroll journal entries and reconcile wages, deductions, employer taxes, payroll liabilities, and related cash activity. Check automated postings to prevent duplicate entries. 

Coordinate payroll tax filings and payments with the payroll provider; investigate notices and discrepancies and support workers’ compensation reporting, audits, and year-end reporting. 

Obtain required approvals, verify sensitive employee changes through established procedures, maintain supporting documentation, and protect employee information. 



Staff Accounting and Month End Close 



Process vendor bills and record cash and other assigned transactions with complete support, appropriate account and job coding, and required authorization. 

Prepare bank, credit card, payroll liability, and other assigned balance sheet reconciliations; investigate differences and track unresolved items. 

Prepare assigned close schedules and journal entries, including accrued payroll and prepaids, with clear calculations, supporting documentation, and appropriate cutoff. 

Support gross profit by job, budget-to-actual reporting, and other financial analyses. Investigate unusual balances, material variances, and incorrect job allocations. 

 



Communication and Ownership 



Communicate proactively with the Accounting Manager, Finance team, and management about payroll deadlines, missing approvals, discrepancies, and close deliverables. 

Maintain organized work papers, documented procedures, and a clear record of open items and their resolution. 

Identify recurring errors and recommend practical process improvements; support accounting cleanups and assigned special projects.

title: Full-Stack AI & WordPress Engineer: $8-$10/hr (RAG Pipelines, Elementor JSON Schemas, Multi-Tenant Architecture)
description:
We are an established digital agency scaling a proprietary AI-Powered Custom Web Design Engine. This system automates high-end website production for established client brands by ingesting raw discovery inputs (interview transcripts, brand PDFs,
 briefs, mood boards), passing them through a dual-tier RAG memory pipeline, and programmatically generating production-ready Elementor staging pages via the WordPress REST API. 



Once a client approves an initial homepage demo, the platform locks the design tokens (typography, color palettes, button styles, container radii) and automatically rolls out cohesive interior child pages (About, Services, Case Studies, Contact). 

We are not looking for someone who manually clicks inside page builders. We need a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who understands WordPress at an architectural level (JSON template structures, REST API schema injections, hook lifecycles) combined with hands-on mastery of multimodal LLM workflows, RAG pipelines, and vector database multi-tenancy. 



Core Responsibilities:

1. Multimodal Ingestion & Brand Token Extraction:

o Build the ingestion engine using Python (FastAPI) or Node.js to parse client audio transcripts, discovery documents, and visual design screenshots. 

o Leverage multimodal vision APIs (Claude 3.5 Sonnet / GPT-4o) to extract typography scales, spacing grids, container border-radii, and color palettes into a standardized brand_blueprint.json schema. 

2. Dual-Tier Memory Architecture:

o Implement tenant namespace isolation in a vector database (Pinecone or Qdrant) keyed by client_id to prevent proprietary client brief leaks. 

o Architect the Global Agency Memory store to capture anonymized, high-converting layout skeletons and UX structural patterns without storing confidential client copy. 

3. Programmatic WordPress & Elementor Generation:

o Translate AI layout manifests into native Elementor JSON container schemas (flexbox containers, widgets, styling classes, and dynamic tags). 

o Build an authenticated WordPress REST API bridge / custom plugin to remotely instantiate and populate draft pages on staging subdomains. 

4. Approval State Machine & Child Page Propagation:

o Build a token-locking mechanism that freezes approved styles into approved_design_tokens.json upon client sign-off. 

o Program the child page rollout engine to query client-specific vector namespaces for service details, team bios, and company history, mapping that content onto locked structural wireframes. 



Technical Requirements:

• 5+ years of senior full-stack WordPress engineering experience (custom plugins, REST API extensions, WP-CLI, and headless/programmatic data injection). 

• Deep Elementor Internals Knowledge: Proven understanding of how Elementor structures, renders, and stores container data in post meta (_elementor_data JSON schemas). 

• Production RAG & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience building pipelines with LangChain/LlamaIndex, embedding models (text-embedding-3-large), and prompt chaining workflows. 

• Vector Database Multi-Tenancy: Demonstrated experience configuring partitioned namespaces (Pinecone or Qdrant) with strict metadata filtering. 

• Backend Mastery: Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI) or Node.js/TypeScript, alongside modern PHP. 

• Strong focus on code security, data hygiene, and enterprise-grade tenant isolation. 



Preferred / Nice-to-Have:

• Experience working with Unstructured or Whisper API for raw document/audio transcription pipelines. 

• Familiarity with Dockerized WordPress staging environments and automated subdomain provisioning via Cloudflare/WP-CLI. 

• Prior experience building generative website builders or automated layout engines. 



Screening & How to Apply:

To ensure you have thoroughly reviewed our architectural scope and are not an automated applicant, begin your application response with the exact phrase: "SYSTEM ARCHITECT: DESIGN AUTOMATION".



In your submission, please provide:

1. GitHub or Live Production Samples: Share 2–3 links showcasing backend code, custom WordPress REST API plugins, or programmatic JSON generators you have built. 

2. AI / RAG Experience: Detail a specific project where you connected an LLM/vector database to an external CMS or web platform. 

3. Architectural Approach: Briefly explain how you would programmatically map an LLM's structured JSON output into Elementor's _elementor_data post-meta format without breaking the page editor.

4. Availability: State your current weekly availability and how soon you can start on Sprint 1. 

5. And your updated resume.



(Applications without the exact screening phrase or live technical proof will be disqualified immediately.)



Regards,



Phong (Peter) Nguyen.

title: Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse
description:
Clinical Operations Manager – Registered Nurse



Home Health Experience Required



Full-Time Remote Position | Philippines-Based | U.S. Eastern Time Hours



Zeabe is a growing non-medical home care agency based in Delaware, USA. We provide dependable in-home care services and are building the clinical and operational systems needed to support continued growth while maintaining quality, compliance, and excellent client care.



We are looking for an experienced Registered Nurse with genuine Home Health/Home Care clinical operations experience to join us as our Clinical Operations Manager.



Please Read Before Applying



This is not a Virtual Assistant, Healthcare VA, Medical VA, Medical Receptionist, or general administrative position.



To be considered for this role, you must:



Be a licensed Registered Nurse.

Have worked professionally as an RN.

Have direct experience in a Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care environment.

Have meaningful experience managing, coordinating, supervising, or overseeing clinical operations.

Have been responsible for ensuring other people complete required clinical work, documentation, visits, or deadlines.



If your experience is primarily administrative or Virtual Assistant work, even within healthcare, this position is unlikely to be the right fit.



Likewise, holding an RN license alone is not enough. We are specifically looking for someone who has used their nursing background within Home Health/Home Care and understands the operational side of delivering care in the home.



About the Role



The Clinical Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Zeabe's clinical services.



The role ensures clients move smoothly from referral through admission, ongoing supervision, recertification, required clinical visits, documentation, and ongoing service delivery while maintaining accurate records, timely follow-up, and regulatory compliance.



You will work closely with our Clinical Director and serve as the operational leader behind the clinical function.



While the Clinical Director owns overall clinical standards, quality, and clinical leadership, the Clinical Operations Manager owns much of the coordination, execution, monitoring, accountability, and follow-through required to make sure clinical work actually gets completed correctly and on time.



You will work across:



Clinical Support Team

Staffing Coordinator

PRN Registered Nurses

Client admissions

Recertifications

Supervisory visits

Clinical documentation

Clinical scheduling and assignments

Compliance-related follow-up

Operational tracking and reporting



This is primarily a Clinical Operations Management position, not a bedside nursing role.



However, your RN background is essential because you must understand the clinical work you are coordinating, recognize when something does not look right, communicate effectively with nurses, identify potential clinical risks, and understand what needs to be escalated.



Primary Objective



Build and operate a reliable clinical operating system that consistently delivers timely, compliant, accurate, and well-coordinated care.



What You Will Be Responsible For

Coordinate clinical operations from referral and admission through ongoing supervision and service delivery.

Ensure admissions, recertifications, supervisory visits, documentation, and follow-up activities are completed accurately and on time.

Maintain accurate, complete, and compliant clinical records across required systems.

Lead the Clinical Support Team and Staffing Coordinator to deliver consistent operational outcomes.

Coordinate PRN Registered Nurse assignments and monitor completion of required clinical activities.

Identify operational risks, resolve process gaps, and appropriately escalate clinical concerns.

Maintain clear visibility over outstanding clinical work so we know what needs to be completed, who owns it, when it is due, and what requires escalation.

The Experience We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who has actually worked inside Home Health or Home Care clinical operations.



Your experience may include areas such as:



Home Health or Home Care clinical operations

Managing or coordinating field nurses

Admissions or Start of Care processes

Recertifications

Supervisory or reassessment visits

Plans of Care

Clinical documentation review

Chart audits

Clinical compliance

Quality assurance

Tracking required clinical visits

Managing overdue documentation

Coordinating nurses and clinical support staff

Correcting incomplete clinical records

Following up on missed clinical requirements

Clinical scheduling

Home Health EMR/EHR systems

Medicaid, Medicare, VA, Private Duty, or other regulated home-based care environments



You do not need to have performed every item on this list.



What matters is that you have genuine clinical operations experience, rather than simply providing administrative support to people who managed clinical operations.



What This Role Really Requires



This position requires much more than maintaining a task list.



You will be expected to know:



What needs to be completed.

Who is responsible for completing it.

What is currently outstanding.

What is overdue.

What does not appear accurate.

What needs follow-up.

What needs escalation.

What recurring problems need a better system.



If a required nursing visit has not happened, we expect you to notice.



If documentation is incomplete, we expect you to identify it.



If someone tells you something is being handled but it remains unresolved, we expect you to follow it through.



If the same problem keeps occurring, we expect you to help determine why and improve the underlying process.



Leadership and Accountability



We are not looking for someone who simply waits to receive assignments.



The successful person will be comfortable:



Taking ownership of operational outcomes.

Directing and coordinating other team members.

Checking whether work has actually been completed.

Following up when deadlines are missed.

Addressing incomplete or inaccurate clinical documentation.

Asking questions when information does not appear correct.

Holding nurses and support team members accountable for agreed requirements.

Maintaining urgency around important clinical work.

Escalating concerns rather than allowing them to remain unresolved.

Following an issue through until it is fully closed.

Improving processes when the same problem repeatedly occurs.



You should be comfortable having a conversation such as:



"This was due yesterday and has not been completed. What is preventing completion, and when will it be finished?"



You can be professional and respectful while still being clear and firm about expectations.



This Role Is Likely a Good Fit for You If...

You are an RN who has genuinely worked in Home Health/Home Care.

You understand clinical operations beyond simply providing nursing care.

You have coordinated, supervised, or managed nurses or clinical support staff.

You naturally take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.

You notice when a required visit, signature, document, date, or clinical item is missing.

You do not assume something has been completed just because someone says they are working on it.

You continue following up until an issue is completely resolved.

You are comfortable checking other people's work.

You address missed deadlines rather than avoiding uncomfortable conversations.

You work with a sense of urgency while maintaining accuracy.

You enjoy bringing structure and order to complicated clinical workflows.

You prefer clear standards, documented processes, and measurable outcomes.

You can quickly explain the current status of important outstanding items.

You question information when it appears incomplete or inconsistent.

You enjoy improving systems so the same operational problems do not continue happening.





This Role Is Probably Not for You If...

Your healthcare experience is primarily as a Virtual Assistant or Healthcare VA.

You have never worked professionally as a Registered Nurse.

You hold an RN license but have never used it professionally in Home Health/Home Care.

Your nursing background is exclusively bedside hospital nursing with no meaningful Home Health/Home Care operational experience.

You have supported a Clinical Manager but have never personally been accountable for clinical operational outcomes.

You prefer receiving clearly defined individual tasks rather than owning a process.

You avoid following up with people when deadlines are missed.

You are uncomfortable checking another nurse's documentation or work.

You tend to accept that something is being handled without verifying completion.

You regularly need your manager to tell you what to do next.

You dislike detailed documentation, compliance requirements, or structured processes.

You prioritize avoiding uncomfortable conversations over addressing an important missed requirement.

You tend to start many things but struggle to consistently close them.



Required Qualifications



You must have:



An active Registered Nurse license.

Professional experience working as an RN.

Direct Home Health, Home Care, Private Duty, or comparable in-home care experience.

Clinical operations experience.

Experience coordinating, supervising, or managing nurses and/or clinical support personnel.

Experience managing documentation, clinical visits, deadlines, follow-up, or compliance requirements.

Strong written and spoken English.

Excellent attention to detail and documentation accuracy.

Confidence following up on late, incomplete, or inaccurate work.

The ability to distinguish routine operational issues from matters requiring clinical escalation.

Experience using healthcare technology, EHR/EMR software, Home Health software, or comparable clinical systems.

Strong working knowledge of spreadsheets and cloud-based business applications.

The ability to work independently and take ownership.

Availability to work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be particularly valuable:



U.S. Home Health experience

U.S. healthcare experience

Medicaid

VA Community Care

Medicare-certified Home Health

Private Duty/Home Care

Quality Assurance

Clinical compliance

Chart auditing

Managing remote or offshore clinical teams

AlayaCare or comparable Home Health software



These are preferred rather than mandatory unless otherwise stated above.



Systems and Technology



You may work with systems including:



AlayaCare

Microsoft Teams

SharePoint

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word



Front

Aircall

Trainual

Zoom

Claude



You are not expected to have prior experience with every system.



We are much more interested in whether you are comfortable learning technology, using structured systems consistently, and maintaining accurate information.



Working Hours



This is a full-time remote position working:



8:00 AM to 4:30 PM U.S. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday



Please consider the corresponding Philippine overnight working hours before applying.



Compensation



USD $1,800 to $2,400 per month



Compensation will depend on directly relevant experience, including:



Home Health/Home Care experience

Clinical Operations Management experience

RN experience

Leadership experience

U.S. or PH healthcare experience

Overall fit for the position





How to Apply (Read Carefully)



We use structured systems and automation heavily, so attention to detail matters — starting with your application.



Step 1: Apply through OnlineJobs.ph



Step 2: In your application message, mention this EXACT role: Clinical Operations



Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly will not be considered.

title: Experienced Cold Caller — US Business Owners (B2B Outbound) | 6+ Hours Daily
description:
Read this whole post before applying. Applications that don’t follow the instructions at the bottom will not get a reply.



We book meetings for US plumbing and HVAC companies. You call the business owner cold — he did not ask for the call and is not expecting it — qualify him in a few questions, and book a specific meeting time. We run the meeting and close it.



We give you the lead list, the script, the dialler and the training. You are not finding leads and you are not selling. You make the calls and book the meetings.



This role is NOT for beginners. If you have never cold called a stranger who did not ask to hear from you, please do not apply.



Requirements — all of them, no exceptions:

• At least 1–2 years of outbound COLD calling. Truly cold: people who did not request a call. Inbound, customer service, warm leads, opted-in leads and follow-ups do not count.

• Experience calling business owners (B2B) is a strong plus. Calling US homeowners also counts.

• Fully fluent, clear English. A busy US owner must understand you in the first three seconds.

• 6+ hours of dialling a day, Monday to Friday, starting 8:00 AM US Eastern (9:00 PM Manila). This is a night shift. Only apply if you can hold it every week.

• Comfortable with high volume, 150+ dials a day, and with hearing “no” all day without it affecting the next call.

• Your own computer, headset, quiet room and stable internet, plus a real backup for power and internet (inverter, generator, mobile data).

• Every call is recorded. If that bothers you, this isn’t for you.



Who we want: someone driven and hungry who always wants more. Someone who doesn’t stop at 150 dials because the number is hit, but keeps going as long as the leads and the hours allow. Takes coaching, fixes what isn’t working, and never blames the list.



Timeline: we’re hiring over the next two weeks and review every complete application within 3 days.



To apply, your application message must include all of the following:



- Your WhatsApp number with country code

- How many years of cold outbound calling you have, and who you were calling (business owners or homeowners, and which country)

- Your average dials per day in your last cold-calling role

- In 3–4 sentences: the hardest cold call you’ve made, and what you actually said

- A link to a 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) of you reading this as if on a real call: “Hi, is this the owner? I’ll be quick — I work with plumbing and HVAC companies on the estimates that never turned into jobs. Roughly how many estimates does your team send out in a week?”



Applications missing any of the five will not get a reply.

title: Acquisition Training & Performance Coach
description:
PLEASE APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: 
/apply-job-1



About us:



With over 100 years of combined industry experience, the Community Minerals team specializes in the purchase of mineral or royalty rights all over the US. We have earned a stellar reputation with hundreds of satisfied customers and an “A” Rating with the Better Business Bureau. With our proven track record, we continue to serve mineral owners in several states with transparency, accountability, and a personalized experience to meet individual needs.



Job Summary:



The Acquisition Training & Performance Coach is responsible for providing dedicated training, coaching, and performance support to the Acquisition Department. This role focuses on developing role-specific knowledge, skills, processes, and behaviors required for successful performance across Acquisition functions. The role is responsible for delivering Acquisition-specific training, facilitating onboarding and refresher sessions, identifying capability gaps, and providing ongoing coaching to improve contractor performance, quality, productivity, and adherence to established processes and standards.



What You’ll Do:



Training Program Design & Development:

• Design and develop engaging training programs, modules, and materials aligned with Acquisition operational goals and requirements.

• Apply instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies.

• Customize learning solutions based on Acquisition business needs, role requirements, and competency gaps.

• Develop practical learning activities, assessments, and knowledge checks to reinforce understanding and application.

• Update training materials and resources when Acquisition processes, systems, tools, or SOPs change.

• Identify recurring knowledge gaps and develop appropriate training interventions.



Training Delivery & Facilitation:

• Facilitate instructor-led and virtual training sessions for contractors within the Acquisition Department.

• Ensure high-quality delivery and participant engagement.

• Coach and support facilitators/trainers as needed.

• Conduct onboarding, process training, refresher training, and upskilling sessions specific to Acquisition functions.

• Provide additional training or remediation to contractors who require further support.

• Support newly trained contractors during their transition into production.



Performance Coaching:

• Provide individual and group coaching to Acquisition contractors to support continuous performance improvement.

• Review performance results, quality findings, productivity data, and other relevant metrics to identify coaching opportunities.

• Provide timely, constructive, and actionable feedback to contractors.

• Develop coaching or performance improvement plans for contractors who require additional support.

• Monitor progress following coaching interventions and provide follow-up coaching as needed.

• Reinforce correct processes, behaviors, and best practices through continuous coaching.

• Recognize strong performance and encourage continuous development among high-performing contractors.

• Partner with Acquisition Team Leads to support performance improvement while maintaining clear accountability within the operational leadership structure.



Training Needs Analysis & Capability Assessment:

• Conduct training needs assessments within the Acquisition Department.

• Collaborate with Acquisition Team Leads to identify recurring performance issues that may be addressed through training or coaching.

• Analyze performance trends to determine whether gaps are related to knowledge, skills, process understanding, or execution.

• Recommend appropriate training and coaching interventions based on identified needs.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen role readiness, competency, and overall team capability.



Program Evaluation & Continuous Improvement:

• Measure training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics.

• Continuously improve programs based on evaluation results.

• Evaluate whether training and coaching interventions result in improvements in quality, productivity, accuracy, and process adherence.

• Identify recurring performance trends and recommend improvements to training content, coaching strategies, or operational processes.

• Work with Acquisition leadership to address recurring knowledge, skill, and performance gaps.

• Recommend improvements to onboarding, training, coaching, and knowledge reinforcement processes.



Stakeholder Collaboration:

• Partner with the Acquisition Operations Team Lead and Acquisition Team Leads to align learning initiatives with Acquisition operational priorities and performance goals.

• Provide recommendations to Acquisition leadership regarding capability gaps and performance development opportunities.

• Collaborate with Acquisition stakeholders to support process changes, new initiatives, and operational improvements requiring training or coaching.

• Support Acquisition initiatives that require training, coaching, or capability development.



Learning Administration & Reporting:

• Track training attendance, completion, and effectiveness.

• Maintain accurate training records and generate reports.

• Track coaching activities, performance improvement interventions, and competency outcomes.

• Prepare reports on training participation, competency results, coaching activities, and performance trends.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Acquisition training materials and documentation.

• Provide management with insights and recommendations based on training and coaching data.



What We’re Looking For:



Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Education, or related field.



Experience:

• At least 3–4 years of experience in Learning and Development, Training, Coaching, Operations Training, or a related field.

• Approximately 3–4 years of relevant Sales experience, preferably with BPO or outbound Sales experience. Relevant Sales experience and demonstrated capability are highly preferred given the operational requirements of the role.



Technical Skills:

• Strong knowledge of instructional design models

• Experience in creating learning modules, facilitator guides, and e-learning content

• Proficiency in Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms

• Skilled in Microsoft Office tools, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, and Word

• Ability to analyze training metrics, completion rates, and effectiveness reports

• Familiarity with survey and assessment tools for learning evaluation.

• Strong understanding of Sales processes and customer engagement, with the ability to evaluate performance and identify areas for improvement.

• Ability to audit and review customer calls and assess areas such as confidence, engagement, probing, active listening, and adherence to established processes and standards.



Soft Skills:

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Strong facilitation and audience engagement capability

• Stakeholder management and business partnering skills

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking ability

• Effective time management and project coordination skills

• Adaptability in handling diverse learners and changing priorities

• Ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback through performance coaching.



Industry Knowledge:

• Foundational knowledge of upstream oil and gas operations, production, and well lifecycle.

• Understanding of marketed deal structures and acquisition processes is a plus.



Competencies and Attributes:

• Thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first work environment.

• Demonstrates discipline, focus, and reliability in support tasks.

• Aligns with the team’s emphasis on operational excellence, compliance, and support for technical evaluation.

• Open to collaboration, feedback, and process alignment across teams.



What's in it for You:

• Competitive Compensation: Earn $4.19-$4.72 per hour paid in foreign currency, commensurate with your skills and experience.

• Work your way: Remote Work Set-Up enabling you to operate from the comfort and convenience of your own chosen workspace

• Success Incentives: Enjoy company bonuses and performance-driven rewards.

• Soar with Us: Opportunities for career growth and promotions await you.

• Annual Bonus: We value your dedication throughout the year, rewarding you with annual performance bonus shared at the end of the year.

• Performance Raise: Your hard work doesn't go unnoticed. Be ready to seize opportunities for salary increase based on your outstanding performance.

• Performance Incentives: We believe exceptional work deserves recognition. Performance incentives are awarded to individuals who demonstrate outstanding contributions, initiative, and results. It’s our way of celebrating excellence and motivating continued success.

• Discretionary Bonus: At Community Minerals, exceptional work doesn’t go unnoticed. Contractors who consistently go above and beyond may be rewarded with discretionary bonuses, a token of appreciation for outstanding contributions, impactful results, and dedication to excellence. Let your work speak, and the rewards will follow!



Other Requirements

System Requirements

title: Property Utility Specialist
description:
What This Role Is About:



The Property Utility Specialist is responsible for the end-to-end management of utility billing, onboarding, and invoice processing for one of our clients. This role ensures utilities are properly onboarded, bills are processed accurately, autopay/e-billing is implemented, and all related systems and controls are maintained with integrity. The ideal candidate is highly detailed, process-oriented, comfortable with multiple stakeholders and systems, and thrives in a fast-paced asset management environment.



Your Main Responsibilities:



1. Utility Invoice Processing

Receive utility invoices and ensure the utility folder is resolved to zero open items by end of day.

Enter utility invoices per property under the correct name.

Input utilities into the property management software (e.g., AppFolio) using proper GL accounts and property codes.

Maintain passwords/logins for utility accounts

Immediately notify Accounting Supervisor & Treasury Supervisor of any invoice or billing errors.

Provide a daily End-of-Day report to Accounting Supervisor & Treasury Supervisor documenting utility bills entered.

Communicate with the Accounting & Treasury Supervisors when a new utility vendor must be created to process invoices.

Collaborate with Accounting & Treasury Supervisors to resolve any utility invoice anomalies (e.g., unusual charges, late fees).

Update the “BPO Utilities” channel each day with current status and any late fees observed during bill entry.

Assist in setting up utility accounts on autopay linked to the property’s bank account.

Assist in enrolling utility accounts to e-billing

Assist in compiling utility data (usage, invoices, etc.) upon request.

Participate in daily bank proofing, ensuring utility items are correctly reported

2. Utility Onboarding for New/Transitioning Properties

Support the onboarding of utilities for properties ensuring 100% completion prior to the transition date.

Obtain from outgoing management/ownership the list of utilities requiring transition (electric, water/sewer, gas, trash, phone/internet).

Ensure all new utility accounts are set up under the correct property name

Ensure utility account logins are created and stored in the Utility/Vendor Account Workbook folder.

Document each onboarding step on the Onboarding Checklist with supporting documentation 
 confirmation, phone confirmation, contract copies).

Store utility transition confirmations for the property being onboarded.

Escalate any onboarding barriers (missing information, deposits required, ownership paperwork missing) to the Accounting & Treasury Supervisor immediately.

3. Flexible and Adaptable Work

As jurisdictions, utility provider practices, lease terms, and internal processes evolve, adapt to changing workflows and procedures.

Remain responsive to new property acquisitions, portfolio growth or other changes.

What We’re Looking For:

At least 2 years of experience in utility billing, invoice processing, or property-management accounting highly desirable.

Strong sense of ownership and proactive communication — someone who will immediately report any problem or barrier (e.g., utility account issues, vendor set-up delays, login access problems) to the appropriate supervisor.

Prior experience using AppFolio or similar property management accounting software is advantageous.



Technical Skills:

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and ability to learn new systems quickly.

Experience managing passwords/logins securely using tools like Keeper Security or similar.

Familiarity with electronic billing and autopay setup processes.

Attention to Detail & Process-Oriented: Proven track record of accurate data entry, following checklists, meeting deadlines (e.g., zero open items by EOD).

Communication & Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to coordinate with internal teams and external utility providers.

Problem Solving: Ability to identify anomalies, escalate appropriately and follow through to resolution.

Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple properties/portfolios, daily tasks, reporting requirements and onboarding workflows concurrently.

Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where policies and programs may change.

Confidentiality & Integrity: Handle login credentials, financial information and vendor accounts securely and responsibly.



Nice to Haves:



Prior experience in a real-estate asset management company or multifamily/residential portfolio.

Experience in handling tenant billing and administrative fee processes.

Comfortable working under minimal supervision with defined workflows and checklists.

Initiative to improve processes, suggest efficiencies and maintain a clean inbox/folder system.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Role Purpose



Own day-to-day accounting, the monthly close, and accurate financial reporting so leadership can make decisions with confidence. Resolve accounting issues, improve processes, and provide dependable follow-through.



Working Arrangement



- Remote, work-from-home position.

- Reports to the President or designated leadership contact.

- Must maintain consistent availability during agreed US Eastern business hours.

- Hubstaff is required for time tracking, attendance, and work activity monitoring. The successful candidate must accurately track all working hours through Hubstaff and comply with established time-tracking procedures.



The responsibilities below describe the full accounting workload to be covered. Leadership retains payment approvals and banking authority.



Core Responsibilities



1. Month-End Close and Reconciliations



- Own the close calendar and checklist. Prepare and post supported journal entries, accruals, prepaid expense adjustments, and other routine closing entries.

- Prepare or review bank, credit card, loan, and balance sheet reconciliations. Investigate differences, resolve errors, and maintain supporting schedules.

- Prepare monthly financial statements, review them for accuracy, and explain material variances. Identify accounting matters requiring CPA or other specialist review.



2. Billing and Daily Accounting



- Process vendor invoices and credits, verify documentation and approvals, resolve vendor discrepancies, and prepare payments for leadership approval.

- Prepare customer invoices, apply payments, follow up on collections, and maintain expense records. Reconcile customer balances and resolve discrepancies.

- Ensure recurring wastewater operations billing is completed by Tuesday each week. Investigate missed billing, incorrect rates, and customer account discrepancies.

- Maintain appropriate customer and vendor records and prepare or review commission calculations under approved compensation plans.



3. Inventory and Project Accounting



- Reconcile inventory records to the general ledger. Work with operations to investigate quantity, cost, and historical posting differences; document proposed corrections for approval.

- Maintain accurate project, department, and subaccount coding. Support project profitability reporting and improved use of Acumatica’s Project Module.

- Maintain fixed asset and depreciation schedules and obtain CPA guidance on equipment purchases and disposals when needed.



Additional Responsibilities



4. Payroll Accounting



- Review payroll entries posted to Acumatica by ProLogic. Prepare supported reclassifications to the correct departments and subaccounts, and reconcile payroll-related balances.

- Coordinate payroll accounting corrections with ProLogic. Routine payroll processing remains with ProLogic.



5. Reporting and Cash Visibility



- Prepare and maintain cash forecasts using current balances, expected receipts, and scheduled disbursements. Flag collection concerns and upcoming cash needs promptly.

- Support budget preparation, actual-to-budget reporting, and service or project margin analysis. Provide clear explanations of unusual results and recommended follow-up.



6. Compliance Support and Process Improvement



- Maintain sales tax exemption documentation, W-9 records, and 1099 support. Coordinate filing responsibilities and deadlines with the CPA and other providers.

- Compile schedules and records for tax preparation, lenders, and insurance support. Tax return preparation and filing responsibilities are defined separately.

- Document recurring procedures, deadlines, and handoffs. Improve reconciliations, billing, payment workflows, and reporting through practical use of Acumatica and automation.

- Maintain supporting documentation and approval controls. Escalate unresolved discrepancies and significant accounting judgments to leadership; obtain specialist advice when needed.



7. Time Tracking and Accountability



- Accurately record all working hours using Hubstaff in accordance with company procedures.

- Maintain proper time entries and ensure tracked hours accurately reflect actual work performed.

- Follow established attendance, time-tracking, and reporting requirements.

- Communicate promptly with leadership regarding schedule changes, availability, or time-tracking issues.



Required Qualifications



- Demonstrated experience independently completing month-end close and preparing financial statements for a US business, with a working knowledge of US GAAP.

- Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills, including the ability to investigate historical errors and explain proposed corrections.

- Experience with an ERP general ledger and accounting modules. Acumatica experience is strongly preferred; comparable ERP experience is acceptable with a clear learning plan.

- Strong Excel skills and experience with inventory, service, or project accounting.

- Willingness to handle daily transactions as well as closing work and communicate clearly with operations.

- Accounting degree or equivalent demonstrated experience. CPA credential is helpful but not required.

- Consistent availability during agreed US Eastern business hours, clear written communication, and reliable ownership of deadlines.

- Willingness and ability to use Hubstaff for time tracking and work activity monitoring.



What Success Looks Like



- Wastewater operations billing is completed by Tuesday; the monthly close and financial statements meet the agreed schedule.

- Balance sheet accounts have current reconciliations and supporting schedules; unresolved items have an owner and a resolution date.

- Cash forecasts and financial reports are current and useful. Accounting problems are identified early and resolved promptly.

- Working hours are accurately recorded through Hubstaff, with consistent attendance and adherence to agreed schedules.

- Demonstrates the values of agility, responsibility, continuous growth, and thankfulness.

title: Accounting Manager / Controller (U.S. Accounting)
description:
Accounting Manager / Controller (U.S. Accounting)

Full-Time | Remote, Philippines | Long-Term Career Opportunity

Salary: Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

Schedule: Flexible, with availability for meetings with our U.S. team



About Our Company



Promofect is a growing U.S.-based company with approximately $2+ million in annual revenue. We specialize in custom branded apparel, promotional products, and online merchandise stores.



We operate through two brands, Promofect and New York Rush Shirts, serving customers ranging from small businesses to large organizations. Our business combines B2B sales, e-commerce, in-house production, and outsourced manufacturing.



We're looking for an experienced accounting professional who can take ownership of our accounting operations, improve our financial systems, and help us build a stronger foundation for continued growth.



About the Opportunity



Currently, our accounting and finance functions are managed directly by the company owner, who has a professional background in accounting and finance.



We're looking for someone who can take over the day-to-day accounting responsibilities, maintain accurate financial records, develop better reporting, and continuously improve our processes.



The owner will continue overseeing higher-level financial strategy, but we want someone who can independently manage the accounting function without requiring constant supervision or technical accounting guidance.



We can teach you our business. We expect you to already know accounting.



We're not a large corporation with separate departments for every function. At our current size, this position requires someone comfortable wearing multiple hats, handling both detailed accounting work and broader financial projects.



As the company grows, some responsibilities may transition to additional team members. The right candidate will have the opportunity to help build the systems, procedures, and team that support a much larger business.



Key Responsibilities



1. Accounting & Financial Operations



• Take ownership of our daily accounting operations using QuickBooks Online.

• Manage transaction categorization, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

• Oversee 
, vendor payments, invoicing, and collections.

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and transactions from our various sales platforms.

• Manage month-end closing and maintain accurate financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Maintain accurate general ledger records and proper accrual accounting.

• Review existing accounting processes, identify errors or inefficiencies, and make improvements.

• Maintain strong financial controls and organized supporting documentation.



2. Financial Reporting & Analysis



• Prepare accurate daily sales and revenue reports across our different business channels.

• Maintain financial reports, dashboards, and management reporting.

• Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and budget-versus-actual analysis.

• Monitor cash flow, upcoming payments, and financial obligations.

• Develop reporting that helps us understand profitability by customer, order, product category, and business segment.

• Analyze order costs, including products, outsourced manufacturing, in-house production, and shipping.

• Work with management to improve our pricing models using actual financial results.

• Help connect revenue and profitability reporting with sales and marketing data.



3. Tax Compliance & Financial Administration



We have outside U.S. CPAs and tax professionals who handle our business income tax returns and provide specialized tax advice. You will coordinate with these professionals rather than replace them.



Responsibilities include:



• Manage ongoing sales tax reporting and filing processes across applicable U.S. states.

• Help maintain and improve sales tax compliance as the company grows.

• Recognize potential compliance issues and coordinate with outside advisors when needed.

• Manage W-9 collection and 1099 preparation and filing.

• Maintain accurate reporting for customer revenue-sharing programs and related payouts.

• Coordinate with outside accountants and tax professionals to ensure accurate and timely reporting.



4. Systems, Technology & Automation



We use several software platforms, including:



• QuickBooks Online

• 

• Printavo

• InkSoft

• Chipply



Some of these platforms support e-commerce and online merchandise stores, making accurate reconciliation and consolidated reporting especially important.



We want someone who is comfortable with technology and enthusiastic about improving processes.



Responsibilities include:



• Identify accounting tasks that can be simplified or automated.

• Use AI, automation tools, and software integrations to improve reporting, accuracy, and efficiency.

• Improve the flow of financial information between our systems.

• Build reliable, repeatable processes that reduce manual work.

• Continuously suggest and implement practical improvements.



Advanced AI development experience is not required. However, we expect you to already be using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your day-to-day accounting work, and to bring curiosity, strong technical aptitude, and a forward-looking approach to modern tools.



5. Payroll & Administrative Support



As a growing company, we also need flexibility across certain administrative and HR-related responsibilities.



You'll work alongside existing team members to help oversee:



• Employee time tracking and payroll processing.

• Sales commissions, bonuses, and incentive calculations.

• Payroll-related reconciliations and records.

• Employee administrative records and important milestones.

• Other finance-related administrative processes as needed.



These responsibilities may evolve or be delegated as the company grows.



Required Qualifications



• At least 5 years of professional accounting experience, including significant experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

• A stable career history, including at least 3 years in a single in-house role where you held real responsibility for a company's accounting (not freelance or multi-client bookkeeping).

• Active, hands-on use of AI tools in your current accounting work.

• Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accrual accounting.

• Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

• Proven ability to independently manage full-cycle accounting and monthly closing.

• Experience preparing accurate financial statements and performing account reconciliations.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong attention to detail, accountability, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and make sound accounting decisions.



Preferred, but Not Required



• Experience as an Accounting Manager, Controller, Assistant Controller, or senior accountant with broad responsibilities.

• Experience in e-commerce, distribution, manufacturing, or order-based businesses.

• Experience with cost accounting, job costing, budgeting, and financial analysis.

• Familiarity with U.S. sales tax compliance.

• Experience with AI, automation, reporting tools, or software integrations.

• Experience improving accounting systems for a growing small business.

• Previous experience supervising or training accounting staff.



A CPA qualification is not required. Demonstrated accounting competence and real-world experience are more important to us.



Who We're Looking For



The right person is an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership and improving the way things work.



We're looking for longevity. You've held an important accounting role within one company for several years, grew with that business, and were trusted with real responsibility. If your experience is mainly freelance work or outsourced bookkeeping across many small clients, this role is likely not the right fit.



You're forward-looking. You think ahead, anticipate problems before they happen, plan for growth, and already use AI and modern tools to work smarter.



You're comfortable handling everyday accounting transactions, but you also enjoy analyzing financial information, building better reports, and finding opportunities to improve the business.



You don't need to be an expert in every area of finance, technology, or tax. You do need to be resourceful, understand your responsibilities, recognize when specialized advice is needed, and take initiative to get things done.



We're especially interested in someone who has worked in a growing business and understands the need to balance day-to-day responsibilities with building better systems for the future.



We value independent thinking, accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and a willingness to continuously improve.



Growth Opportunity



This position will initially report directly to the company owner.



Our goal is to develop an organized, accurate, and efficient accounting function that can support the company as it grows.



Over time, you may have the opportunity to supervise additional accounting staff and take on broader responsibilities.



As the company expands, we may eventually introduce additional senior financial leadership. Our goal is for this position to remain an important part of a strong and scalable finance department.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow their career with us and become a valued, long-term member of our team.



This is a full-time position dedicated to our company, not a freelance opportunity. We're looking for someone ready to commit to one company for the long term.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and answer the following questions. We're looking for specific examples from your actual professional experience rather than generic responses.



1. Accounting Experience

Describe your experience managing accounting for U.S.-based companies. Have you independently handled the full accounting cycle, including monthly closing and financial statements?



2. Ownership & Problem-Solving

Tell us about a time you took over an accounting function, discovered problems, or improved existing processes. What did you personally accomplish?



3. Financial Reporting & Analysis

Describe your experience with budgeting, financial reporting, job costing, or profitability analysis. Have you built reports that helped management make better financial decisions?



4. Technology & Automation

Which AI tools do you use in your accounting work today, and how? Share a specific example of how AI, automation, or other technology improved an accounting process.



5. Working in a Growing Business

Are you comfortable being hands-on with daily accounting while also helping with payroll, reporting, and other administrative responsibilities as needed? Describe any similar experience.



6. Career Stability

What is the longest role you've held at a single company? How long were you there, what was your title, and what were you responsible for?



7. Compensation & Availability

What is your expected monthly salary in USD, and when would you be available to start?



We're looking for someone who can take ownership, deliver accurate work, improve our processes, and grow with our company. Qualified finalists may be asked to complete a paid practical accounting assessment.

description:

Over 2.5 million babies have been worn in our carriers. The original design of the wrap has not changed in 15 years— proof of a great concept. When we see a parent wearing their babe in one of our carriers, we know that Boba has helped forge a little link that brings two hearts together. Today, Boba has grown from a small, family-run, shoestring operation to a global team dedicated to bringing that magical bond from our families to yours.



About the role

Legal and Compliance Coordination: Work with the legal team to address intellectual property issues, product suspensions, and unauthorised sellers.



Customer Experience: Collaborate with the Customer Experience Manager and offshore customer service team to deliver outstanding customer support for your products.

Supply Chain Coordination: Ensure products meet quality standards, remain in stock, have updated packaging, and comply with all necessary certifications.

About you

3+ years of experience in product management, marketing, or an analytical role in a fast-paced environment, preferably a startup.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, draw conclusions, and make actionable recommendations.

15 days of paid vacation per year.

title: Client Delivery Manager ( YouTube Project Manager)
description:
Client Delivery Manager ( YouTube Project Manager) | Full-Time - Remote



The role in one paragraph

Your job is to make sure every client request and every video, script and thumbnail project moves from submission to delivery without being missed, delayed or left without an owner. You are the operational owner for a portfolio of clients: visible in Slack, coordinating the internal team, keeping Airtable true, resolving blockers and raising risks before the client feels them. This is not a passive task-tracking role. You are the person who makes sure the work actually moves and every loop closes.



About Views To Clients



Views To Clients is a fast-growing YouTube growth and production company working with some of the world's leading founders and brands, including Gary Vee, Manychat and Instantly.ai. We are building the strongest YouTube delivery operation in the market and need high-ownership operators who can keep pace with that ambition.



What you own:

Own the day-to-day delivery health of a portfolio of clients.

Be present in client Slack channels, acknowledge operational requests and give clear progress updates.

Turn client messages, submissions and decisions into properly owned work with a clear deadline.

Coordinate scriptwriters, editors, QAs, thumbnail designers, strategists and other internal owners.

Make sure new work is assigned the same day and accepted by the person responsible.

Track projects through delivery, chase progress and intervene before an issue becomes a missed deadline

Keep Airtable and the operating system aligned with reality at all times.

Identify blockers and weak plans early, then resolve or escalate them with a proposed next action

Verify that the correct result reaches the client before marking anything resolved.

Maintain clear daily visibility across what is healthy, at risk, overdue and unresolved.



Where the role stops

The Strategist owns YouTube strategy and results direction. QA and functional leaders own the quality standard inside their disciplines. Client Success leadership owns higher-stakes relationship calls, renewals, saves, expansion and commercial decisions.



You do not need to personally execute every specialist task, but you cannot treat another person's ownership as a reason for a client outcome to drift. Your job is to route the issue correctly, secure a credible commitment and make sure it reaches resolution.



Who will be exceptional here

You have strong agency project-management, client-delivery or creative-operations experience.

You have controlled several recurring client workstreams and cross-functional teams at once.

You naturally notice missing owners, vague deadlines and silent risks before somebody points them out.

You are direct, calm and comfortable holding talented people accountable.

Your written English and client communication are excellent.

You can prioritise quickly when several clients need attention at once.

You use systems such as Airtable, Asana, ClickUp or Monday as operational truth, not decoration.

You ask questions early, make sensible decisions without waiting for permission and close loops without being chased.



What success looks like

Clients do not need to chase us for status.

Actionable requests are captured and assigned within the required SLA.

Risks are raised before deadlines are missed.

Every live item has a clear owner, next action and deadline.

The system matches the real state of delivery.

Internal owners know exactly what is expected and by when.

Problems reach the client as controlled solutions, not silent surprises.
