title: Senior Meta Ads Strategist - Paid Social (Fashion Ecommerce, Part-Time)
description:
Work from home, 20 hours per week, with a growing Australian fashion brand.



We're hiring a senior Meta Ads / Paid Social Strategist for a growing Australian fashion and luxury ecommerce brand with international markets. This is a strategy and ownership role, not a junior media-buying seat.



The brand already has someone handling day-to-day Meta execution, and a daily insights feed of Meta data. What they need next is a senior person who owns the strategy, manages meaningful budget decisions, and turns numbers into clear growth actions. Vague "keep optimising" answers will not cut it.



If you are strongest at pushing buttons in Ads Manager and waiting for instructions, this is not your role. If you read between the metrics, spot opportunities early, and can tell a commercial lead exactly what to do next, keep reading.



About the role

- Fractional / part-time (20 hours per week), remote, with Australian business-hours overlap.

- Fashion / luxury / ecommerce focus.

- You will work alongside the existing Meta execution person and use the daily insights feed, then go further: interpret, prioritise, and drive the plan.

- Primary work is strategic oversight, budget allocation, performance diagnosis, testing frameworks, and commercial recommendations, not pure day-to-day campaign clicking.

- You will manage stakeholders independently: brief the commercial lead in plain English, challenge weak plans with data, and leave clear next actions each week.



What you'll own

1. Strategy and budget: Own Meta paid social strategy. Recommend when to scale, hold, cut or reallocate spend across campaigns, products and markets. Comfortable managing meaningful Meta budgets (state your largest monthly budget in your application).

2. Performance diagnosis: Analyse ROAS, MER, CAC/CPA, CPM, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, AOV and contribution margin. Find waste, creative fatigue, audience issues and scaling opportunities.

3. From insight to action: Take daily Meta data/insights and turn them into prioritised commercial actions the team can execute the same week.

4. Testing and creative direction: Design practical tests across creative, audiences, offers and markets. Brief what to test next and why.

5. Tracking and measurement: Sense-check Pixel, Conversions API, attribution and Shopify vs platform results; flag gaps fast.

6. Mentoring the executor: Guide the existing Meta team member with clear frameworks so day-to-day work improves without you taking over every click.

7. International growth: Advise on market testing and efficient expansion (AU / US / UK / EU experience valued).

8. Stakeholder communication: Run a simple reporting rhythm for non-specialists: what is working, what is not, and where to invest next.



Must-haves

- 5+ years hands-on Meta Ads for ecommerce / DTC (not leads-only as your primary background).

- Proven ownership of Meta strategy and budget, not only campaign setup or brief execution.

- Advanced Meta Ads Manager / Business Suite; solid on Pixel, CAPI and attribution.

- Can translate metrics into plain-English commercial recommendations and defend them with data.

- Confident working independently and managing stakeholders without heavy day-to-day oversight.

- Fluent spoken and written English (must-have).

- Available for Australian business-hours overlap on a 20 hr/week schedule.



Nice to have

- Premium fashion, luxury, apparel or lifestyle ecommerce.

- Shopify + GA4 trading fluency; inventory-aware marketing.

- Fractional / consulting / senior agency strategist background.

- Multi-market Meta (AU, US, UK, Europe).



How to apply

Apply on OnlineJobs.ph with subject line META STRATEGY - [Your Name]. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.



In your application, attach your updated CV, confirm you can work 20 hours/week with Australian business-hours overlap at USD $15/hour, and answer these three questions:

1. Strategy and budget ownership: Tell us about a time you owned the Meta strategy and budget for an ecommerce brand. What was the monthly budget, what decisions did you make on where to scale, hold or cut spend, and what was the result (with numbers)?

2. Turning data into action: A brand gets a daily Meta insights report. What do you look for between the numbers, and give one example of an opportunity you spotted in the data that you turned into an action that grew sales.

3. Leading the executor: The brand already has someone running day-to-day Meta campaigns. How would you guide them in your first 30 days so the account is driven by a clear strategy, not just execution?



We are hiring for strategy ownership. Execution-only profiles will not progress.

title: Supply Chain Manager (Multi-Channel E-commerce, Asia-to-Europe Imports)
description:
READ THIS FIRST

We do not review applications sent through Onlinejobs.ph. That includes messages, the Apply button and attached resumes. The only way to apply is through the form linked at the bottom of this post.



ABOUT OLVY

Olvy B.V. is a Dutch consumer brand selling kitchen and home appliances across Europe and the UK, on Amazon and through other sales channels. We make our products in China, ship them by sea to Europe and fulfil through Amazon FBA and outside fulfilment partners. We're growing into more countries and channels. We need one person to own inventory, freight and partner performance so the supply chain keeps up with that growth.



This is not a coordinator or VA role. You'll set the rules that others follow. You'll also manage a Supply Chain Coordinator.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. Inventory planning

- Set safety stock, coverage targets and reorder points, and explain the reasoning behind each number

- D
 order quantities around supplier MOQs and full-container limits

- Build and maintain a rolling 12-month forecast that covers seasonal peaks and promotional events

- Watch inventory health and act early on overstock and slow sellers

- Direct the weekly replenishment runs to every fulfilment channel through your Coordinator



2. Imports from Asia to Europe

- Negotiate incoterms, prices and payment terms with suppliers

- Plan sea, rail and air shipments, and cost the freight premium against what a stockout would cost

- Improve container use and bring down freight cost per unit sold

- Handle customs, import documents and EU product compliance issues



3. Fulfilment partners and suppliers

- Define SLAs with 3PL and fulfilment partners, measure them and review them every month

- Escalate or replace partners who miss their SLAs

- Rate suppliers on actual lead time, delivery reliability and quality

- Arrange pre-shipment inspections and follow up on what they find



4. Data, reporting and processes

- Own the KPI definitions and report forecast accuracy every month

- Question what the tools say. When a report looks wrong, check it against the real data.

- Document processes so the work doesn't depend on one person

- Design the logistics setup for new countries and channels, including storage, returns, imports and VAT registration with finance



5. Must-Haves (please don't apply without all 7)

- 5 to 10 years in supply chain, including at least 2 years where you were responsible for inventory norms or a fulfilment network. Following rules someone else set doesn't count.

- Hands-on experience importing from Asia to Europe: incoterms, sea freight, container planning and customs. Domestic-only or US-only logistics doesn't qualify.

- Experience managing outside 3PL or fulfilment partners against written SLAs. You should be able to name the metrics and what happened when a partner missed them.

- Inventory planning at the parameter level. You've set safety stock or coverage figures yourself and can explain why they sit where they do.

- Strong analytical skills. You build your own analysis on large datasets, and you've caught a system or report that was wrong.

- E-commerce or marketplace fulfilment experience, such as restock and capacity limits, storage fees and returns. Amazon FBA experience is a strong plus.

- Fluent written and spoken English, good enough to negotiate with suppliers and push back on management.



WHAT D
 BETWEEN GOOD CANDIDATES

- You take initiative without waiting for the work to be laid out for you

- You've managed at least one direct report. Coordinating peers doesn't count.

- You can work well without a mature ERP or documented processes, and you build what's missing

- You push back on management when you disagree, and you back it up with numbers



NICE TO HAVE

- Lean, Six Sigma or similar process improvement work with measured results

- Experience with EU product compliance such as CE marking and product documentation

- Experience building a supply chain from scratch, not just running one that already existed



THIS ROLE IS PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF

- Your experience is mainly general VA work, admin or listing management

- You've only worked in B2B, retail or manufacturing distribution, with no e-commerce

- You've carried out replenishment but never set the parameters behind it

- Freight forwarders have always handled imports for you with nobody checking their work



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out our application form and upload your resume here:

👉

title: AI Video Ad Editor for Meta (UGC + B-roll + AI) – DTC Retro Camera Brand
description:
WHO WE ARE



DigiDispo is a young brand that sells a screen-free digital camera. It feels like a disposable camera: no screen, so you stay in the moment instead of looking at a display. You transfer the photos to your phone afterwards. We sell online across (mostly) Europe and beyond. Meta 
 + Instagram) is our main growth channel.



We test a lot, and there is a lot of room to grow. We want people who grow with us.



THE ROLE



You turn our briefs into conversion-focused video ads for Meta, using a mix of:

- Real footage from our own B-roll bank (people using the camera, travel, nights out, friends)

- AI-generated content (AI creators, scenes, voiceovers)

- Combinations of both



Most of your work is based on our weekly briefs. Our scripts are written on purpose, so we can test specific stories and lines. You d
 the format, pacing, characters and scenes.



But we don't want someone who only follows orders. You get:

- Insight into which of our ads perform and which don't

- Competitor ad libraries and ads from brands we learn from

- A real say in our creative strategy: your ideas get tested, and when they win, you get paid for it (see bonuses)



We are always willing to learn. If you know something we don't, we want to hear it.



YOUR OWN IDEAS



You are free to make ads from your own ideas, on top of the brief. As many as you like, as long as the quality stays high. One great ad is worth more to us than ten average ones, and we judge both: quality first (based on performance), then volume. Your own ideas count toward your agreed weekly hours. When one of your own ideas becomes a winner, the bonus is yours.



WHAT A WEEK LOOKS LIKE



- 16-24 hours per week

- 2-3 batches per week. 1 batch = 3 concepts x 3 opening variations = 9 ready-to-run videos (9:16, plus 4:5 when asked)

- You log your hours and what you did; we pay weekly via Wise

- Brief and deadline in PH time.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- You have made direct-response video ads for Meta or TikTok that actually ran as paid ads. Not weddings, vlogs or corporate.

- You understand why an opening stops the scroll, why people keep watching at second 3, and what makes someone buy

- Hands-on experience with AI video tools (for example Higgsfield, Kling, Seedance, Veo, ElevenLabs) and the judgment to redo a generation that looks fake instead of shipping it

- Strong in CapCut, Premiere or similar: pacing, captions, sound, clean export

- You can mix real footage and AI so nobody sees the difference

- Product honesty: our camera must always look exactly like the real one.

- Good written English and reliable communication. You ask before you build when something is unclear, and you tell us BEFORE a deadline if you need more time.

- You genuinely like the brand, you spot opportunities and you want to take them



Somewhere in your application, tell us what your favorite food is.



PAY AND BONUSES



- $4.50 per hour to start, for the hours you actually work

- Generous performance bonuses: a one-time bonus of up to $400 for every concept you made (from our brief or your own idea) that becomes a winning ad. A winning ad = an ad that has proven to make us money after enough spend and sales to judge it fairly. We pay it once that is proven. You have insights in all our data.

- We pay the AI generation credits for DigiDispo work

- When the work is good, hours and pay grow with us. We pay well for performance, because growth for both sides is how we want to work.



HOW TO APPLY



Answer all 5:

1. Links to your 3 best video ads that ran as paid ads. At least one with AI-generated content. For each: which tools you used, what YOU did, and roughly how long it took.

2. How many finished vertical ads can you make in one working day, starting from a script and existing footage? A real number. We will test it.

3. Look at our website (digidispo.shop). Give us one ad idea for DigiDispo in max 3 sentences.

4. Your rate, your hours per week, when you can start, and which editing software and computer you use.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We watch your work and read your answers

2. A 20-minute video call

3. A PAID test batch from a real brief (you sign our creator agreement first)

4. If it clicks: a 30-day trial, then long-term



We'd rather get 10 serious applications than 300 copy-paste ones. If this sounds like you, apply today.

title: Video Team Manager & Quality Checker (E-commerce Ads)
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe. All of our ads are videos made by our in-house team of video editors, and we're looking for a sharp, organised manager to lead one of our editing teams and any other adhoc tasks.



Our editors are split into two teams. You'll manage your own team of 4 editors, while our other manager runs the second team. You'll mainly work independently but also working alongside the AD analyst/product researcher to d
 on what tasks to assign next.



What you'll do:

- Plan your team's work for the next day. Our product researcher and ads analyst will tell you which products need ads and which ads need refreshing, and you d
 what gets made and in what order

- Most of the work is new ads for new products, plus fresh ads for products that are already winning

- Assign video projects to your editors and make sure every deadline is met

- Review every video before it goes live and check it for mistakes: captions, spelling, timing, cuts, music, product shots and overall quality

- Send clear revision notes to your editors and check that every fix is done properly

- Keep track of your editors' hours and overtime

- Upload and publish the finished ads (easy to learn, we'll show you how)



Captions and languages:

Our ads run across Europe, so most of our videos have captions and voiceovers in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German and Dutch. You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Management experience: leading a team, planning work, assigning tasks and following up

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $700/month for 4 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

  - Few or no mistakes making it into live ads

  - Deadlines met and your team delivering on time

  - Strong, consistent output from your editors

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale



How to apply:

1. Start your message with "QUALITY CHECK" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about your management experience: how many people you managed and what the work was

3. Tell us about your experience with video production or editing

4. Portfolio or examples of previous work

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Remote (Philippines) | Contractor (full-time)



Location: Remote (Philippines), with in-person team meetups in Manila quarterly

Engagement: Full-time contractor, with paid public holidays, annual leave and sick leave

Experience: 3–5 years of professional design experience and/or a relevant degree

Team: Our growing Philippines-based creative team

You'll love it if: you have a strong eye, clear creative opinions and want to grow your skills with AI and emerging tools



About Kitto

---------------

Kitto is a specialist marketing agency working exclusively within the recruitment industry. We partner with recruitment businesses around the world to help them stand out through strategic, creative marketing. Our services include branding, design, video production, animation, and copywriting.



We operate as a fully remote global team, collaborating across time zones to deliver high-quality creative solutions. We embrace AI as part of how we work, using it to work smarter while keeping creative thinking and quality at the centre of everything we deliver.



The role

-----------

We are looking for an experienced Graphic Designer to join our growing creative team. You will play a key role in delivering high-quality visual assets across a wide range of client projects, supporting recruitment brands at different stages of growth.

We are not looking for generic, templated design output. We want someone with a strong eye, clear creative opinions, awareness of trends, and evidence of this in their portfolio.



You will be joining a growing Philippines-based function that is increasingly central to the success of the wider agency, working from home, with in-person meetups twice a year for collaboration and celebrations. You should be reasonably accessible to Manila for these.



What you'll do

--------------------

Design and creative delivery:



- Create high-quality visual assets across print and digital channels, including social media, presentations, brochures, and branded documents

- Design logos and visual identities in line with client briefs and brand guidelines

- Produce assets for both organic and campaign-based marketing activity

- Use AI tools where they add value, for example in ideation, mock-ups, image editing and producing asset variations, applying your own judgement to every output

- Ensure all creative work meets brand, quality, and accessibility standards



Collaboration and communication:



- Work closely with account managers and the creative team to understand briefs, objectives, and timelines

- Clearly communicate design concepts and rationale to internal stakeholders

- Participate in feedback and iteration cycles, refining designs based on client and internal input

- Share what you learn about new tools and techniques, helping shape how the creative team works



Brand and quality control:



- Maintain consistency across all client brand touchpoints

- Apply strong design thinking to solve visual communication challenges

- Manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritising workloads effectively and flagging capacity issues when required



How we use AI:

We use AI to work smarter, not to replace creative thinking. You will be encouraged to explore and adopt AI tools that speed up production, unlock new ideas and raise the quality of what we deliver, while your eye, judgement and craft stay at the heart of the work. We are looking for someone who:



- Is curious about AI and actively experiments with new tools and techniques

- Can use AI tools (e.g. Adobe Firefly, Photoshop Generative Fill, Canva AI, Midjourney or similar) to support ideation, asset creation and image editing

- Applies strong creative judgement to AI output, knowing when to use it, when to refine it and when not to use it at all

- Uses AI responsibly, respecting client confidentiality, brand guidelines and intellectual property



You do not need to be an expert. We care more about curiosity and a willingness to learn than about knowing every tool.



What you'll bring

-----------------------

Essential:



- Design capabilities. You must be confident creating:

- Social media assets for multiple platforms (including LinkedIn)

- Brochures and professionally designed documents

- A wide range of print and digital assets (e.g. event banners, business cards,
 signatures)

- PowerPoint presentations

- Logos and visual identity elements



Skills:



- Strong understanding of typography, colour theory, layout, and composition

- Strong written and spoken English, demonstrated through qualifications or professional experience

- Clear and confident communication, including explaining and justifying design decisions to non-design stakeholders

- Excellent time management and organisational ability, comfortable in a fast-paced agency environment with multiple concurrent briefs

- A growth mindset and a genuine interest in developing your skills with AI and emerging tools



Tools:



- Adobe Creative Suite (particularly Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign)

- Canva

- Microsoft 365 (particularly Word and PowerPoint)



Nice to have. Experience in the following would be an advantage, but is not required:



- Animation

- Photo editing (e.g. headshots, office photography)

- Video editing (e.g. podcasts, social media clips)

- Newsletters and landing pages

- Brand design and development

- Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects

- A strong point of view on design and creative direction

- Awareness of current design trends and the ability to apply them appropriately

- Evidence of continued professional development



If you are developing skills in any of the above, we welcome examples of self-led learning or practical application.



About you

---------------

We are looking for someone who is:

- Collaborative and team-oriented

- Confident but not ego-driven, with strong creative judgement and pride in producing thoughtful, considered work

- Trustworthy and dependable

- Proactive in communicating workload and challenges

- Motivated to grow with the business as we continue to expand, and to keep evolving your skills as the industry and its tools change



Your portfolio

-------------------

A strong portfolio demonstrating a range of design work is essential. It should show more than basic layout work: we are looking for evidence of concept development, visual judgement, and considered design thinking.



Examples of AI-assisted work are welcome. If you include any, add a short note on your process and how you used AI alongside your own design skills.



What we offer

-------------------

- Fully remote working

- Structured contractor engagement with paid public holidays, annual leave, and sick leave entitlement

- A collaborative and supportive team environment

- Exposure to a wide variety of global recruitment brands

- Opportunities to develop skills across branding, campaigns, and emerging tools, including AI

- Support and time to build your AI skills, experimenting and learning alongside the team

- Mentoring and professional support

- Twice-yearly in-person team meetups



Kitto is committed to maintaining fair and transparent holiday and sickness policies that support work/life balance and wellbeing across our global team.

title: Customer Support VA – London Comedy Club | UK Hours | Full Time
description:
We are a comedy club in London looking for a reliable full-time Virtual Assistant to handle customer
s and help coordinate replacements when comedians drop out.



PAY AND HOURS

• £700–£850 per month, depending on experience and performance in the assessment.

• 13th-month pay, pro-rated for time worked.

• 40 hours per week: Tuesday–Saturday, 12:00 noon–8:00pm UK time.

• You must be comfortable working these UK hours all year, including UK daylight-saving changes. In the Philippines this is 7:00pm–3:00am during UK summer time and 8:00pm–4:00am during UK winter time.

• Preferred start: this week, subject to completing the selection process.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• Read and respond to customer
s in clear, warm and accurate English.

• Check bookings and follow our procedures for ticket questions, transfers, missing tickets and complaints.

• Recognise exceptions and escalate them to the manager rather than inventing an answer or promising something you cannot authorise.

• Own comedian dropout handling during your shift: use our SOP, comedians database and WhatsApp groups to find a suitable replacement, confirm the booking details, update the record and hand over to front of house. Keep confirmations clear and avoid duplicate bookings.

• Answer occasional customer phone calls confidently and professionally.

• Keep your tasks and unresolved issues up to date, and hand urgent matters to the front-of-house team at 8:00pm UK time.



WHAT WE NEED

Excellent written and spoken English, sound judgement and a dependable working pace. You should be able to move through routine enquiries efficiently, prioritise urgent issues and follow up without losing track of outstanding work. You will need a reliable internet connection, computer, headset and a suitable place to take calls.



Customer support experience is valuable. Experience with Gmail, ticketing systems, WhatsApp and task-management tools is useful. Comedy-industry experience is not required.



TRAINING AND SUPPORT

We provide SOPs, reply templates, existing tools and a structured four-week training programme with practice exercises and weekly reviews. Our manager leads the training. Responsibility increases as you demonstrate that you can do the work accurately and independently.



HOW TO APPLY

Please use exactly 7 Apply Points and include:

1. A short summary of your relevant customer support experience and the tools you have used.

2. Confirmation that you can work Tuesday–Saturday, noon–8:00pm UK time throughout the year.

3. Confirmation that the salary range works for you and your earliest possible start date.

4. Confirmation that you have a computer, reliable internet and a headset suitable for phone calls.

5. A link to a 60–90 second video of you speaking English. Briefly introduce yourself, then answer: “A customer calls because they cannot find their tickets and the show starts in 30 minutes. What would you say, and what would you check?” Please make sure we can open the link.



ASSESSMENT AND NEXT STEPS

The next stage is a short, unpaid, independent online assessment with a 30-minute time limit. We provide the relevant SOP sections first. You will write three brief customer replies, explain your decisions in short English videos, and choose a suitable replacement for a 10-minute comedy spot using simulated WhatsApp replies and a searchable training spreadsheet. No real customer work or messages to comedians are involved.



Complete the assessment here: 



Enter your full name and OnlineJobs.ph profile so we can match your work to your application. Include the submission reference in your OnlineJobs.ph application, alongside the five items above. If you have already applied, reply to your existing application with the reference. No appointment or separate login is needed. Check your camera and microphone before starting; the timer starts when you press Start.



We assess accuracy, written and spoken English, judgement, attention to detail and working pace. Complete it yourself without AI-generated answers or another person’s help. Strong candidates will have a call with our manager, followed by an agreed paid trial week before a longer-term decision. Trial work is paid whether or not we offer the permanent role.



If you have already received an individual invitation to a paid assessment, the payment terms in that invitation still apply.

4. Confirmation that you have a computer, reliable internet and a headset suitable for phone calls.

5. A link to a 60–90 second video of you speaking English. Briefly introduce yourself, then answer: “A customer calls because they cannot find their tickets and the show starts in 30 minutes. What would you say, and what would you check?” Please make sure we can open the link.



ASSESSMENT AND NEXT STEPS

The next stage is a short, unpaid, independent online assessment with a 30-minute time limit. We provide the relevant SOP sections first. You will write three brief customer replies, explain your decisions in short English videos, and choose a suitable replacement for a 10-minute comedy spot using simulated WhatsApp replies and a searchable training spreadsheet. No real customer work or messages to comedians are involved.



Complete the assessment here: 



Enter your full name and OnlineJobs.ph profile so we can match your work to your application. Include the submission reference in your OnlineJobs.ph application, alongside the five items above. If you have already applied, reply to your existing application with the reference. No appointment or separate login is needed. Check your camera and microphone before starting; the timer starts when you press Start.



We assess accuracy, written and spoken English, judgement, attention to detail and working pace. Complete it yourself without AI-generated answers or another person’s help. Strong candidates will have a call with our manager, followed by an agreed paid trial week before a longer-term decision. Trial work is paid whether or not we offer the permanent role.



If you have already received an individual invitation to a paid assessment, the payment terms in that invitation still apply.

title: Copywriter - Direct Response Meta Ads
description:
We’re a fast-growing DTC brand serving the US market. We’re hiring a direct-response copywriter to do the work of a creative strategist: owning our ad creative from customer research and angles to scripts, briefs and performance analysis.



You don’t need creative strategist experience. If you write copy that converts and deeply understand customers and why they buy, you already have the skill we want. We’ll train you on the rest.



This is a results-driven role. You'll start with a documented process and a clear testing system, but we're not hiring someone to just follow it. You're measured on profitable spend scaled through your creatives, with clear targets set for each month of your first quarter. People who beat the playbook and keep improving it grow with us.



What you'll do



- Run daily competitor/winning-ad breakdowns

- Do deep, evidence-based audience research

- Develop angles, hooks, and full scripts on iterating proven winners or adapting competitor structures, while testing new formats.

- Assist in developing landing page and advertorials.

- Collaborate with editors. You must be hands-on with AI image, and voice generation. 

- Analyze every launched ad against its metrics and report learnings and next tests to your manager

- Lead a weekly meeting with video editors





Job Requirement:



- 2+ years of proven experience writing copy for cold traffic, particularly Meta

- Strong customer-research, persuasion and storytelling skills

- Ability to develop angles and copy independently rather than only executing pre-written directions

- A track record of copywriting that drove measurable results (scaled spend at profitable ROAS/CPA)

- Sharp analysis and can explain why an ad won or lost and turn it into the next test





Why join

High ownership working directly with the founder, a fast creative-to-result loop, and room to grow into a creative strategy lead as we scale. Long-term collaboration preferred.





How to apply: Applications are only accepted through the form below. Submit your resume and all your answers there. Anything sent outside the form won't be reviewed. Thank you!

title: Title Analyst
description:
PLEASE APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: 
/apply-job-1



About us:



With over 100 years of combined industry experience, the Community Minerals team specializes in the purchase of mineral or royalty rights all over the US. We have earned a stellar reputation with hundreds of satisfied customers and an “A” Rating with the Better Business Bureau. With our proven track record, we continue to serve mineral owners in several states with transparency, accountability, and a personalized experience to meet individual needs.



Job Summary:

The Title Analyst will be responsible for evaluating the title ownership of real property in the United States. Strong preference for the role to be filled with someone with a legal research and diligence background. This role presents an exciting opportunity for an individual who is passionate about the title industry and eager to contribute their expertise to our growing organization.



What You'll Do:

- Conduct comprehensive research to trace the chain of ownership and rights of mineral properties, examining deeds, leases, land records, and relevant legal documents.



- Identify potential title issues, such as encumbrances, liens, conflicting claims, or missing documents, and assess their impact on mineral acquisition.



- Generate essential legal documents, including title reports, ownership summaries, and transfer documents, to support the acquisition process.



- Prepare Exhibits and Summarized Legal Descriptions, including plotting of legal descriptions (platted metes and bounds, sectional properties)



What We're Looking For:

- Graduate of any bachelor's degree

- 1-5 years of in-depth experience with Title Research of real property in the United States



Technical Skills:



- Strong research, analytical, and critical thinking skills.



- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications and CRM Software.



- Ability to review, interpret, and summarize legal documents accurately, including deeds, leases, probate records, assignments, and other title-related instruments.



- Ability to interpret legal descriptions, including Township-Range-Section, Lot and Block, and Metes and Bounds.



- Experience conducting research using county clerk records, tax appraisal district (TAD/CAD) websites, public records, and online title research databases.



- Familiarity with GIS mapping tools, document management systems, and online public record repositories is an advantage.



- Ability to identify and resolve title defects, ownership discrepancies, and chain of title issues through research and analysis.



- Strong data entry and documentation skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.



- Ability to prepare clear, concise, and well-organized title reports and supporting documentation.



- Ability to manage multiple research assignments while maintaining productivity and quality standards.



Soft Skills:

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.



- Effective written and verbal communication skills.



- Strong organizational and time management skills.



- Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple assignments effectively.



- Problem-solving and sound decision-making skills.



- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



- Strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.



- Adaptability to changing priorities, processes, and business requirements.



- Accountability and ownership of assigned work.



- Willingness to learn and continuously improve.



- Resilience and the ability to perform effectively under pressure.



- Professionalism and a positive attitude toward feedback and collaboration.



Industry Knowledge:

- Basic understanding of the oil and gas industry, particularly mineral ownership, royalty interests, and the mineral acquisition process.



- Basic knowledge of mineral rights, property law, and title examination principles related to oil and gas interests.



- Familiarity with legal documents commonly used in mineral title research, such as deeds, leases, probate records, assignments, affidavits, and other title instruments.



- Understanding of legal descriptions, chain of title, and ownership determination concepts.



- Awareness of applicable laws, regulations, and industry practices governing mineral ownership and title research.



- Familiarity with U.S. county recording systems and public records research is an advantage.



Competencies and Attributes:

- Sales-oriented

- Motivated and driven

- Ability to work under pressure

- Ability to multitask and prioritize

- Adaptability to changing legal requirements and industry standards.

- Time management and the ability to meet deadlines and prioritize tasks.

- Ethical conduct and a commitment to maintaining the integrity of title analysis.



What’s in it for you:

- Work your way: Remote Work Set-Up enabling you to operate from the comfort and convenience of your own chosen workspace

- Success Incentives: Enjoy company bonuses and performance-driven rewards.

Other Requirements:

title: SEO, SEM, Technical Website Optimization & Digital Marketing Responsibilities
description:
Advanced SEO, SEM, Technical Website Optimization & Digital Marketing Responsibilities



**This is a hands-on position. You must be able to identify, troubleshoot, and correct marketing and website problems yourself, or work directly with our team to implement and verify the solutions.**



We expect strong, practical knowledge of the following areas.



### Technical SEO & Website Optimization (On-Page and Backend)



- Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits and implement corrective action plans.

- Diagnose and resolve crawling, indexing, and search visibility issues.

- Manage XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, meta robots directives, and indexing controls.

- Identify and correct broken links, redirect chains, 404 errors, soft 404s, and improper 301/302 redirects.

- Identify duplicate content, keyword cannibalization, thin pages, and orphan pages.

- Improve website architecture, navigation, URL structure, and internal linking.

- Monitor Core Web Vitals, including LCP, INP, and CLS.

- Improve mobile usability, responsiveness, loading speed, and overall user experience.

- Optimize images, file sizes, alt text, and relevant video metadata.

- Understand JavaScript rendering issues that affect search engines.

- Review and improve HTML headings, title tags, meta descriptions, and crawlable content.

- Work within website content management systems (CMS) to make improvements.

- Understand HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript well enough to troubleshoot and implement appropriate website fixes.

- Use Google Search Console, Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, and SEO auditing platforms to identify and resolve problems.

- Test and verify changes after implementation rather than simply marking tasks complete.



### Schema Markup & Structured Data



- Create, implement, update, validate, and troubleshoot JSON-LD structured data.

- Maintain appropriate LocalBusiness and relevant business subtype schema.

- Implement Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Article, BlogPosting, VideoObject, and other applicable structured data.

- Use FAQPage, Review, AggregateRating, and other markup only where appropriate and compliant with search engine guidelines.

- Ensure business names, locations, addresses, contact information, hours, and related details are consistent.

- Verify structured data using 
 Validator and Google Rich Results Test.

- Monitor structured data warnings, errors, and search eligibility changes.

- Understand that schema supports search engine interpretation but does not guarantee rankings or rich results.



### Advanced On-Page SEO & Content Strategy



- Develop keyword strategies based on local intent, search volume, competition, and conversion opportunity.

- Optimize location pages, storage unit pages, service pages, landing pages, blogs, and FAQs.

- Create effective content clusters and internal linking strategies.

- Address keyword cannibalization and content overlap.

- Improve content relevance, readability, accuracy, and search intent alignment.

- Develop unique content for individual storage locations and their local markets.

- Optimize page titles, descriptions, headers, images, and content hierarchy.

- Conduct content audits and refresh underperforming or outdated pages.

- Develop SEO content that supports actual customer questions and rental decisions.

- Review and correct AI-generated content before publication.

- Maintain consistency across all brands without duplicating generic content across locations.



### Off-Page SEO, Brand Trust & Authority



- Develop and execute sustainable, quality-focused backlink acquisition strategies.

- Identify relevant local, industry, business, and community linking opportunities.

- Research competitor backlink profiles and identify credible opportunities.

- Manage business citations and ensure consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) information.

- Identify and correct inaccurate, duplicate, or outdated business listings.

- Build brand authority through relevant digital PR, industry relationships, local organizations, and credible mentions.

- Pursue appropriate local sponsorships, partnerships, and community visibility opportunities.

- Monitor brand mentions, referral traffic, and backlink quality.

- Identify potentially harmful or manipulative link-building practices.

- Build meaningful trust signals through accurate business information, authentic testimonials, helpful content, and transparent customer communication.

- Avoid link schemes, paid ranking manipulation, and other practices that could harm our websites or reputation.



### Google Business Profile, Google Maps & Local SEO



- Audit, optimize, and maintain Google Business Profiles for all applicable locations.

- Manage business categories, services, descriptions, attributes, photos, videos, and business hours.

- Monitor and resolve duplicate listings, ownership issues, suspensions, and other GBP problems.

- Improve location-page relevance and consistency with the corresponding GBP.

- Analyze local competitors and monitor geographic map rankings.

- Track calls, direction requests, website visits, and other GBP engagement metrics.

- Coordinate authentic customer review generation and professional review responses.

- Improve local citation quality and business information accuracy.

- Develop strategies to improve relevant local search visibility and customer engagement.

- Understand that local search performance depends on relevance, distance, and prominence, not simply keyword placement.



### AEO, GEO & AI Search Visibility



- Develop strategies for Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

- Structure content to clearly answer customers' common questions.

- Improve brand and business information consistency across websites and credible third-party sources.

- Use appropriate structured data and semantic HTML to improve machine-readable content.

- Build credible brand authority through original, accurate, and useful information.

- Monitor brand visibility and citations where measurable in AI-assisted search.

- Identify opportunities for visibility in Google AI experiences, ChatGPT search, Bing/Copilot, and other relevant platforms.

- Understand the limitations of AI visibility tools and avoid unsupported promises of guaranteed placement.



### SEM, PPC & Paid Digital Advertising



- Develop, audit, manage, and improve Google Ads campaigns.

- Understand Search, Performance Max, remarketing, and other relevant campaign formats.

- Review campaign structure, search terms, bidding strategies, budgets, ad copy, and negative keywords.

- Manage or support Meta/Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.

- Audit conversion tracking and paid campaign attribution.

- Identify wasted spend and improve lead quality, cost per lead, and acquisition cost.

- Coordinate paid advertising with SEO, website content, local campaigns, and rental promotions.

- Evaluate landing-page performance and recommend or implement improvements.

- Work alongside our existing PPC specialist and assist with hands-on execution when needed.



### Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Lead Generation



- Evaluate the entire customer journey from search result to completed rental.

- Identify and correct friction in website navigation, calls to action, forms, and online rental processes.

- Improve location pages and landing pages to generate more qualified leads.

- Optimize mobile call buttons, contact forms, rental buttons, and lead capture.

- Review website analytics, user behavior, and conversion funnels.

- Coordinate A/B testing when traffic volume supports reliable results.

- Identify opportunities to improve lead-to-rental conversion rates.

- Connect marketing performance to actual rental activity and revenue.



### Analytics, Tracking & Marketing Reporting



- Implement, maintain, and troubleshoot Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.

- Configure and validate website events, conversion goals, and campaign tracking.

- Audit Google Ads and Meta conversion tracking.

- Understand UTM parameters, attribution, cross-domain tracking, and call tracking.

- Work with available rental management and CRM data to connect marketing activity to leads and completed rentals.

- Build useful reporting dashboards using Looker Studio or comparable tools.

- Monitor rankings, website traffic, local visibility, leads, advertising performance, and conversion rates.

- Identify tracking errors or discrepancies before presenting reports.

- Provide actionable recommendations supported by data.



### Social Media, Video SEO & Digital Brand Management



- Guide organic and paid social media strategy across multiple brands and locations.

- Plan and execute location-specific campaigns and seasonal promotions.

- Review and improve social media messaging, creative, captions, and posting schedules.

- Optimize video titles, descriptions, captions, and supporting website content.

- Coordinate short-form video, educational content, testimonials, and promotional campaigns.

- Maintain brand voice, accuracy, and consistency.

- Monitor social media engagement, referral traffic, and measurable lead generation.

- Collaborate with our existing social media and video team while personally assisting with content and execution as needed.



### Hands-On Leadership & Problem Solving



**You are expected to LEAD and DO.**



You must be able to:



- Personally perform technical SEO and marketing tasks when necessary.

- Identify problems before leadership or clients bring them to your attention.

- Fix issues directly when you have the access and expertise to do so.

- Work with team members or developers when a problem requires additional resources.

- Prioritize work based on business impact, urgency, and available hours.

- Review and verify completed work.

- Manage projects, content calendars, deadlines, and reporting.

- Communicate professionally with U.S.-based partners and clients.

- Provide direction and accountability without micromanaging.

- Accept feedback, adjust priorities, and implement changes quickly.



**We are not seeking someone who knows a little marketing terminology but cannot execute. We need a technically capable, well-rounded digital marketer who understands strategy, can work independently, can collaborate with a team, and knows how to turn marketing efforts into qualified leads and business growth.**



We are looking for someone who stands out through real experience, original thinking, initiative, and proven ability.



Take the time to review our websites:











Tell us what you actually see. What needs improvement? What opportunities are we missing? What would you fix first, and how would you approach it?



We don't expect perfection, and we aren't asking for a free, comprehensive marketing audit. We want to see how YOU think, what YOU know, and what YOU can actually do.



We use AI ourselves, and we're not against it. But if you cannot independently identify problems, develop solutions, and explain your recommendations without relying entirely on AI, this is not the position for you.



Show us something that makes you different from the other applicants. We are looking for a leader, a problem-solver, and a doer—not someone who simply knows how to write a good application.

title: Sales & Customer Service Specialist (AI-Savvy) - 1026
description:

Remote (UK business hours) | Front Row Furniture

Full-time | 40-45 hours per week

Salary: Competitive, based on skills and experience | TBD



About Us:

Front Row Furniture is a trusted UK-based supplier of quality contract furniture for the events and hospitality industries. Our clients range from event planners and venues to restaurants and hotels, and they rely on us for stylish, durable and affordable furniture backed by excellent service and reliable delivery. We're a small, close-knit remote team, and we're actively bringing AI into how we work across sales, customer service and operations.



The Role:

We're looking for an exceptional Sales and Customer Service Specialist who is tech friendly and genuinely enthusiastic about AI. You'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, handling enquiries by phone,
, website live chat and online marketplaces, turning leads into orders and making sure every customer gets a quick, clear and helpful answer.



You won't use AI just because you're told to. You're the kind of person who already uses tools like ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to work faster and smarter, and you're excited to help us build better ways of working.



What You'll Do:

*Sales and lead handling: understand what customers need, recommend the right products, send quotes and follow up until the order is secured.

*Customer service: respond quickly and clearly to enquiries by phone,
 and live chat, and handle questions, concerns and after-sales support with a solutions-first attitude.

*Order and delivery updates: keep customers informed on stock, dispatch and delivery, and work with our logistics side to resolve any issues.

*Platform management: monitor and update product listings and messages on our website and online marketplaces (e.g. eBay, Gumtree, Amazon).

*Systems and records: keep leads, orders and customer records accurate and up to date in our systems (such as Odoo and Google Sheets).

*AI in your daily work: use AI tools to draft replies, research products, summarise information and speed up routine tasks, always checking the output before anything goes to a customer.

*Process improvement: follow our SOPs, suggest improvements, and share ideas on where AI and automation could save time.

*Feedback loop: pass customer insights back to the team to help improve our products, processes and messaging.



What Success Looks Like:

*Enquiries are answered quickly and professionally, and more of them turn into orders.

*Customers always know where their order is.

*Records are accurate, so the rest of the team can rely on them.

*You regularly find smarter, faster ways to do the job, including with AI.

*You become a trusted, go-to person for both customers and colleagues.



What We're Looking For:

*1-3+ years of experience in sales or customer service, ideally with UK, US or international clients.

*Clear, confident spoken and written English. UK or neutral accent strongly preferred.

*Warm, personable and confident on the phone, with a natural sales mindset.

*Tech friendly: you pick up new systems quickly and are comfortable with Google Sheets, CRMs or order management tools.

*AI enthusiast: you use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar) at work or in daily life and can give real examples.

*Good judgement: you know when AI helps and when a situation needs a human touch, and you always check AI output for accuracy.

*Organised, punctual and detail-oriented.

*Proactive and self-managing in a remote setup.

*Reliable WFH setup (fast, stable internet, quality headset, quiet space, backup power if needed).



(Bonus if you've worked with Amazon, eBay, Gumtree or other marketplaces, Odoo or a similar ERP/CRM, B2B sales, order tracking, or the furniture, events or hospitality industries. Not required!)



Why Join Us?

*Make an impact: your work directly shapes customer experience and sales growth.

*Supportive team: SOPs, training and ongoing support provided, with leadership that values ideas and initiative.

title: Accounting Manager / Controller (U.S. Accounting)
description:
Accounting Manager / Controller (U.S. Accounting)

Full-Time | Remote, Philippines | Long-Term Career Opportunity

Salary: Competitive, based on experience and qualifications

Schedule: Flexible, with availability for meetings with our U.S. team



About Our Company



Promofect is a growing U.S.-based company with approximately $2+ million in annual revenue. We specialize in custom branded apparel, promotional products, and online merchandise stores.



We operate through two brands, Promofect and New York Rush Shirts, serving customers ranging from small businesses to large organizations. Our business combines B2B sales, e-commerce, in-house production, and outsourced manufacturing.



We're looking for an experienced accounting professional who can take ownership of our accounting operations, improve our financial systems, and help us build a stronger foundation for continued growth.



About the Opportunity



Currently, our accounting and finance functions are managed directly by the company owner, who has a professional background in accounting and finance.



We're looking for someone who can take over the day-to-day accounting responsibilities, maintain accurate financial records, develop better reporting, and continuously improve our processes.



The owner will continue overseeing higher-level financial strategy, but we want someone who can independently manage the accounting function without requiring constant supervision or technical accounting guidance.



We can teach you our business. We expect you to already know accounting.



We're not a large corporation with separate departments for every function. At our current size, this position requires someone comfortable wearing multiple hats, handling both detailed accounting work and broader financial projects.



As the company grows, some responsibilities may transition to additional team members. The right candidate will have the opportunity to help build the systems, procedures, and team that support a much larger business.



Key Responsibilities



1. Accounting & Financial Operations



• Take ownership of our daily accounting operations using QuickBooks Online.

• Manage transaction categorization, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

• Oversee 
, vendor payments, invoicing, and collections.

• Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, payment processors, and transactions from our various sales platforms.

• Manage month-end closing and maintain accurate financial statements in accordance with U.S. GAAP.

• Maintain accurate general ledger records and proper accrual accounting.

• Review existing accounting processes, identify errors or inefficiencies, and make improvements.

• Maintain strong financial controls and organized supporting documentation.



2. Financial Reporting & Analysis



• Prepare accurate daily sales and revenue reports across our different business channels.

• Maintain financial reports, dashboards, and management reporting.

• Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and budget-versus-actual analysis.

• Monitor cash flow, upcoming payments, and financial obligations.

• Develop reporting that helps us understand profitability by customer, order, product category, and business segment.

• Analyze order costs, including products, outsourced manufacturing, in-house production, and shipping.

• Work with management to improve our pricing models using actual financial results.

• Help connect revenue and profitability reporting with sales and marketing data.



3. Tax Compliance & Financial Administration



We have outside U.S. CPAs and tax professionals who handle our business income tax returns and provide specialized tax advice. You will coordinate with these professionals rather than replace them.



Responsibilities include:



• Manage ongoing sales tax reporting and filing processes across applicable U.S. states.

• Help maintain and improve sales tax compliance as the company grows.

• Recognize potential compliance issues and coordinate with outside advisors when needed.

• Manage W-9 collection and 1099 preparation and filing.

• Maintain accurate reporting for customer revenue-sharing programs and related payouts.

• Coordinate with outside accountants and tax professionals to ensure accurate and timely reporting.



4. Systems, Technology & Automation



We use several software platforms, including:



• QuickBooks Online

• 

• Printavo

• InkSoft

• Chipply



Some of these platforms support e-commerce and online merchandise stores, making accurate reconciliation and consolidated reporting especially important.



We want someone who is comfortable with technology and enthusiastic about improving processes.



Responsibilities include:



• Identify accounting tasks that can be simplified or automated.

• Use AI, automation tools, and software integrations to improve reporting, accuracy, and efficiency.

• Improve the flow of financial information between our systems.

• Build reliable, repeatable processes that reduce manual work.

• Continuously suggest and implement practical improvements.



Advanced AI development experience is not required. However, we expect you to already be using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your day-to-day accounting work, and to bring curiosity, strong technical aptitude, and a forward-looking approach to modern tools.



5. Payroll & Administrative Support



As a growing company, we also need flexibility across certain administrative and HR-related responsibilities.



You'll work alongside existing team members to help oversee:



• Employee time tracking and payroll processing.

• Sales commissions, bonuses, and incentive calculations.

• Payroll-related reconciliations and records.

• Employee administrative records and important milestones.

• Other finance-related administrative processes as needed.



These responsibilities may evolve or be delegated as the company grows.



Required Qualifications



• At least 5 years of professional accounting experience, including significant experience working with U.S.-based businesses.

• A stable career history, including at least 3 years in a single in-house role where you held real responsibility for a company's accounting (not freelance or multi-client bookkeeping).

• Active, hands-on use of AI tools in your current accounting work.

• Strong working knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accrual accounting.

• Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

• Proven ability to independently manage full-cycle accounting and monthly closing.

• Experience preparing accurate financial statements and performing account reconciliations.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong attention to detail, accountability, and organizational skills.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and make sound accounting decisions.



Preferred, but Not Required



• Experience as an Accounting Manager, Controller, Assistant Controller, or senior accountant with broad responsibilities.

• Experience in e-commerce, distribution, manufacturing, or order-based businesses.

• Experience with cost accounting, job costing, budgeting, and financial analysis.

• Familiarity with U.S. sales tax compliance.

• Experience with AI, automation, reporting tools, or software integrations.

• Experience improving accounting systems for a growing small business.

• Previous experience supervising or training accounting staff.



A CPA qualification is not required. Demonstrated accounting competence and real-world experience are more important to us.



Who We're Looking For



The right person is an experienced accounting professional who enjoys taking ownership and improving the way things work.



We're looking for longevity. You've held an important accounting role within one company for several years, grew with that business, and were trusted with real responsibility. If your experience is mainly freelance work or outsourced bookkeeping across many small clients, this role is likely not the right fit.



You're forward-looking. You think ahead, anticipate problems before they happen, plan for growth, and already use AI and modern tools to work smarter.



You're comfortable handling everyday accounting transactions, but you also enjoy analyzing financial information, building better reports, and finding opportunities to improve the business.



You don't need to be an expert in every area of finance, technology, or tax. You do need to be resourceful, understand your responsibilities, recognize when specialized advice is needed, and take initiative to get things done.



We're especially interested in someone who has worked in a growing business and understands the need to balance day-to-day responsibilities with building better systems for the future.



We value independent thinking, accuracy, reliability, efficiency, and a willingness to continuously improve.



Growth Opportunity



This position will initially report directly to the company owner.



Our goal is to develop an organized, accurate, and efficient accounting function that can support the company as it grows.



Over time, you may have the opportunity to supervise additional accounting staff and take on broader responsibilities.



As the company expands, we may eventually introduce additional senior financial leadership. Our goal is for this position to remain an important part of a strong and scalable finance department.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow their career with us and become a valued, long-term member of our team.



This is a full-time position dedicated to our company, not a freelance opportunity. We're looking for someone ready to commit to one company for the long term.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume and answer the following questions. We're looking for specific examples from your actual professional experience rather than generic responses.



1. Accounting Experience

Describe your experience managing accounting for U.S.-based companies. Have you independently handled the full accounting cycle, including monthly closing and financial statements?



2. Ownership & Problem-Solving

Tell us about a time you took over an accounting function, discovered problems, or improved existing processes. What did you personally accomplish?



3. Financial Reporting & Analysis

Describe your experience with budgeting, financial reporting, job costing, or profitability analysis. Have you built reports that helped management make better financial decisions?



4. Technology & Automation

Which AI tools do you use in your accounting work today, and how? Share a specific example of how AI, automation, or other technology improved an accounting process.



5. Working in a Growing Business

Are you comfortable being hands-on with daily accounting while also helping with payroll, reporting, and other administrative responsibilities as needed? Describe any similar experience.



6. Career Stability

What is the longest role you've held at a single company? How long were you there, what was your title, and what were you responsible for?



7. Compensation & Availability

What is your expected monthly salary in USD, and when would you be available to start?



We're looking for someone who can take ownership, deliver accurate work, improve our processes, and grow with our company. Qualified finalists may be asked to complete a paid practical accounting assessment.
